(1) At the 16 kg/m3 core, no core/face split gains more than 1.3%: the best is SF 0.234 at faces 0.337 mm and core 0.113 m, zero margin, with face stress rising from 635 to 708 MPa. Redistribution at that density confirms the direction; it does not move it. (2) At the best split the modelled SF scales as 1/core density: 0.47 at 8 kg/m3, 0.93 at 4, and 1.0 near 3.7 kg/m3 with a 0.49 m core. That happens only because core shear and wrinkling are omitted (NFI-SAND). If the card moves the core, put the omitted limits beside it as property targets. Crimping, 2*Gc*d/R, needs Gc of about 1 MPa or more at 0.49 m. Wrinkling, about 0.5*(Ef*Ec*Gc)^(1/3), needs Ec*Gc near 4e16 Pa^2 (about 200 MPa each) at 710 MPa face stress. The pre-1969 sandwich cylinders in CR-1457 Fig. 4.2-3 sit near SP-8007, at 0.42 to 0.76; FPL 1830 reads 0.42 and 0.44 at R/rho 1050 and 1300. The only measured sandwich domes are Saturn S-II, in CR-1457 Fig. 6.2-3, which I read from the page: two hemispheres at 0.22 to 0.24 (R/rho about 240, Vc unrecoverable) and ellipsoids at 0.39 to 0.99. No shell of any form was measured at Vc 0.9 to 2. Verdict: as a sphere, both leads are beyond the record. 021's 0.595 is 2.5 to 3.3 times it and 021b's 0.468 is 2.0 to 2.6 times, against the S-II hemispheres and against SBKF carried on the handbook sphere-to-cylinder ratio of 0.30 to 0.34. As a cylinder, 021b is at the edge (the pre-1969 record gives about 0.46 at its R/rho, and it sits on SP-8007), while 021 is beyond the pre-1969 record (about 0.43, so 1.39 times) and at the edge of SBKF scaled (0.54 to 0.65). Only a direct cylinder-to-sphere transfer, which no source supports, puts them inside. The best results needed AFP or autoclave faces on stiff honeycomb and measured, modelled shape. 029's FE is the instrument; the record cannot settle Vc 1. Every value is QUESTIONABLE; nothing here is a certification.

MAINLINE-032 checked independently. All 236 numerical/display/source-constant comparisons pass, including all 155 engineering/Boolean RESULTS scalar leaves. Owner timing is metadata. Artifact pins match; no owner code was read or run.

CR-1457 Eq. 2.2-12 and Kdelta reproduce. Fc is the lowest flatwise core compression, core tension and core-facing bond strength. Stabilized compression supplies a conditional candidate, not automatically Fc. Hexcel confirms 60 psi typical, 35 psi minimum average and 15 ksi typical modulus. Typical crush 35 psi is a separate property. Bond/tension values remain missing.

Lead amplitudes at Fc=60 psi reproduce: S-200F/Q0.371, 0.152868766846361 mm; SR-200/Q0.609, 0.0652229064039409 mm. At 35 psi: 0.0891734473270440 and 0.0380466954022988 mm.

The wrinkling cubic gives b=0.6823278038280193; applying it to the waviness-adjusted uniaxial capacity does not count waviness twice. Intracell dimpling uses its separate 0.5 interaction factor, reproducing 9.0188536848 and 4.9753091211.

Correct the CARD's lead-only amplitude/cell range to 0.00684754923–0.01604921437. Its printed 0.0046–0.024 spans all four typical-strength cases. The underlying rows are correct.

Ten nonblocking findings cover this correction, minimum-average interpretation, rounded targets, strength/thickness data, plasticity, wavelengths, metrology and shell transfer. The author correction is verified; SAE class values remain unread. CHECK contains exact deltas, primary-source audit and reconstructed curve artifacts. QUESTIONABLE remains. No successor job.

MAINLINE-036 complete. No matched minimum compressive yield for finished thin SR-200 faces was established. The maker's 345 MPa minimum is tensile; inspected MIL-HDBK-5J/MMPDS sheet Fcy cells are blank. Historical thicker-sheet compression supports plausibility, not gauge/process/biaxial qualification. PS-200/PF-60 catalogs add no compression basis.

Held R10 requirements are 300.333 MPa for the scarf routes and 321.580 MPa for light bond/ideal weld. Held R20 requires 338.744 MPa face stress and 376.382 MPa material strength with its 0.9 joint efficiency. Re-optimization preserves each predecessor's pressure, reserves and joining law.

With full projected gamma/wrinkling and catalog E=290 GPa, R10 minimum strengths are 298.906 MPa nominal scarf, 300.135 primer, and 298.257 light-bond routes. R20 needs 375.839 MPa under original elastic inputs, or 381.612 MPa with handbook sheet scalar elasticity; historical 379.2 then yields only SF=0.994817. Scalar elasticity is itself unvalidated for the formed orthotropic hull.

Compression qualification is an additional unresolved material assumption. Existing buckling, wrinkling and joining assumptions remain open; installed-hull SF is unknown. Gauge tolerances and additional finishing are treated separately without double-counting etch.

Seventeen input pins and 218 checks passed; 14 evidence rows and 15 NFI items filed. Brief names no successor: stop and file, awaiting robotics' next queued job.

MAINLINE-033 complete. Primary account uses the actual 028 joining bill; the retained 027 five-percent allowance is a separate comparison.

Across R=10,15,20,30,50 m, the six-shell-mode least set is gamma+Q. Required factors fall from 1.98718/1.83621 to 1.79862/1.63551, with no strength improvement. Minimum-usage payload is zero; full-endpoint SF1 payload at R50 is 89,422.443 kg. Literal handbook gamma=.20/Q=.33 has no radius under the model's ideal envelope.

Full-endpoint pair crossings: gamma+Q 6.822342 m; Q+strength 16.281907 m on the crimp gamma=1 branch; gamma+strength 103.892276 m only outside published sheet gauge. No single suffices in the searched model.

With the 10 MPa scarf screen, all three at R10 still miss by 12.7995 kg; gamma+Q first passes at 10.350852 m and carries 41,318.067 kg at R50 full endpoints. Retaining the 027 allowance moves the Q+strength shell crossing to 40.470112 m.

Every mode, factor, budget and sensitivity is filed. Independent checks: 10,289/10,289 scalar comparisons, 381 geometries, 61/61 dense-search cases. Nine NFIs; material inputs QUESTIONABLE, outputs PROJECTION, installed-hull SF unknown. Brief says stop/file; no next job is named.

MAINLINE-037. QUESTIONABLE. 022d has not filed. The P2 lead is the full-named SR-200 scarf on CR-III 5056, least factor 1.006358. Faces work at 298.436 MPa, factor 1.156 on the 345 MPa tensile yield. At gamma 0.20 the same point is 0.33958 by global. In-band P3 is Mylar at 0.41179 by Perry and titanium with Kapton at 0.74170 by global. The 6.15 m and 5.5 m optima are outside the half-wave band.

The gradient is 1.7717 MPa per kelvin. A white coating, absorptance 0.20 and emittance 0.90, leaves 0.399 K and 0.707 MPa. Pattern bending is 0.818 MPa. The average rise is 3.48 K. Bare beryllium reaches 356.9 K and puts 621 kPa into the core, factor 0.388. Coated, that factor is 1.678 from the air temperature and 0.917 from the cold night. A complete sphere carries no membrane stress from the solar pattern.

The flight gust, 35 ft/s at 35 knots, leaves the lead at 1.003303. Table 4's 70-knot wind, mapped as a uniform excess, leaves 0.998442. The 016 mooring load is 48.259 kN. The bare patch is factor 0.354. One pad, 0.200 m2 and 8.65 kg, restores crush to 1. The 70-knot pad is 33.1 kg.

Sun and wind leave the in-band P3 factors at 0.41051 and 0.74123. Wall area to reach 1 is 5863 kg and 1634 kg, more than the lift can take. The open choices are the coating, the bond temperature, and the mooring wind. No next job.

CHECK MAINLINE-031. QUESTIONABLE. Not a certification. The owner's card is not rewritten. The arithmetic is independent of the owner's scripts.

No mismatch at the printed precision. On the +10 K day a hull that spends the whole nominal lift floats at 130.743168802 m. The descent is 369.256831198 m and the pressure ratio is 1.04352463813, and the printed rise is 4.352464 percent. The optimistic hot, low and humid root is -23.1899446984 m, ratio 1.05124131370. The conservative root is -1015.87666729 m, ratio 1.15057969742. Both are below sea-level ground.

The optimistic 100 m floor leaves 55.340908918 kg absent. The nominal factor is 1.03655296198. The least set is gamma, wrinkling and panel. The reserve is 616.42770583 kg against the filed 021b reserve of 775.729373623 kg. The reoptimised 500 m reserve is 775.564514536 kg. The card already calls the 0.165 kg difference search refinement.

The P3 source row is 022b's 019-reserve point at s 6.15 m. Half-wave over bay side is 0.56789497714, the out-of-band result under 030's test. Every reoptimised SiC row runs from s 6.05484150028 m to 6.21294354919 m, ratio 0.567666840223 to 0.568829578353. The optimistic 100 m ratio is 0.568723983864 and its least factor is global. The Ti and Kapton rows are inside the band and remain 0.719959139001 and 0.648078133464. The objection is NFI-CHECK-031-HALF-WAVE. The 3900 MPa value and the 1.5 GPa film remain NFI-CHECK-031-PASS-CONDITIONS. This check names no next job.

MAINLINE-034 complete, QUESTIONABLE/PROJECTION. For the inherited 24-hour mission, select ground evacuation then sealed service at an estimated 30–50 kg onboard for both leads; retain the existing 100 kg allowance. Assembly gas-load measurement and evacuation of every cell/bore remain conditions.

Conditioned source-rate hot-pressure limits are 398.2/7.76/19.49 days for P2/Kapton P3/Zylon-barrier P3. Times to 48.894 kg free gas are 464.9/13.97/35.83 days. These are conditional gas calculations, not qualified endurance; the assumed power package supports at most nine days of 5 W monitoring.

Both P3 frames are SiC; CFRP denotes end wraps. Unvented ambient air would retain 43.4/88.2/76.1 kg. Outgassing changes phase of existing onboard mass; external ingress adds mass, and getters retain it. Water beds and powered pumps are explicitly sized; the continuous P3 benchmark is 292.3 kg and its Kapton speed is 2.3% short under assumed conductance.

Zylon vacuum equipment plus barrier/attachment and fitting adhesive totals 91.6–111.6 kg; no payload credit. Kapton structural SF remains below one.

36 numerical/source checks pass; 53 upstream/prior pins unchanged. The manifest pins 77 files, including sources, calculator, curves and delivery checks. Seventeen nonblocking physical/source NFIs remain. No upstream code inspected, imported or run. Stop-and-file instruction fulfilled; no successor named.

MAINLINE-022d complete; QUESTIONABLE throughout. All 32 combinations have overall and half-wave-constrained optima: 64 full SF, binding-mode, spacing and mass rows. Both Zylon plies are charged. Ti/CFRP joint dimensions and mass use each candidate's multiplier. Film gauge is continuous; tensile bending is constrained at Ft=15.586 MPa, PROJECTION.

Best equilateral overall: Zylon/CFRP, cap, 5% reserve, SF 1.397732582 at s=6.085747 m, half-wave/member=0.569022. Best equilateral screened: SF 1.258252477 at s=3.170759 m; local/global/film bind. Its masses are tubes 4183.590, film 214.542, joints 44.191, nodes 2.927, systems 100, reserve 244.472 and sag lift loss 99.720 kg. Membrane screened SF is 1.251857092; 019 reserve gives 1.194121426 cap and 1.187857743 membrane.

The two-way surrogate numerically leads at 2.010980577 overall and 1.867825477 screened, but its missing shear stiffness leaves those capacities unqualified. Square-cell sag/wave sensitivity lowers the latter to 1.728882831. Passing one-member half-wave is only the requested screen.

Sixteen overall optima fail that screen. Independent reconstruction passes 2800 checks; 112 optimized sensitivity witnesses and eleven open NFI are filed. Wider bounds improve none of sixteen checked cap optima. Qualified full-size allowable and assembly failure probability remain unknown. No next job.

MAINLINE-017b filed. From today's values (handbook gamma 0.20, wrinkle 0.33, stock panels, SR-200 faces on CR-III 5056 3/8-1.0, 028's joining replacing the 5% allowance, 019's reserve scaled by 027), P2 is 0.528 at R 10 m and 0.571 at R 20 m; global buckling binds. Only three properties reach SF 1 alone: a face 1.87/1.73 times lighter at beryllium's stiffness and strength; gamma x4.06/x3.41 (0.81/0.68, a 2.5/13 mm dimple by 015's map); face modulus x2.04/x1.93, only at the fragile Vc 2 step. Core stiffness, flatness, sheet size, film and seams are not alone. Cheapest: the lighter face alone; keeping Be, gamma alone; keeping Be and handbook values, a core stiffer than aluminium can be (product 13.1/9.5).

P3 today (Ti sleeves, Kapton) is 0.710; the projection row (CFRP wrap, Zylon) floats at 1.441. Today's row reaches 1 alone on tube specific stiffness x1.41 (beyond SiC), lattice knockdown x1.99 or film specific strength x3.79. Every P3 route needs a qualified SiC compressive strength of 0.83-1.20 GPa; none exists.

Trends: beryllium, aluminium honeycomb, SiC and the knockdown and wrinkling design values are flat for 30+ years; Be sheet shrank. Only film specific strength moves (2.2%/yr since 1975, 4.1% since 1999): Upilex-S gives x2.17 already, the rest in 14-25 years if it held (PROJECTION). Closest: P3 via film. Step changes: the lighter face, tube stiffness, a large-sphere knockdown, a stiffer core, lattice tests. 34 reproduction checks pass; 15 NFI rows; files pinned. The brief names no next job.

QUESTIONABLE. MAINLINE-026b rigid linear factors: frequency 4, 5.254644 versus continuum 6.193381 (15.16% lower); frequency 2, 2.183661 versus 6.876245 (68.24% lower). Last mesh changes are below 0.0161%. Frequency 6 inherited 6.465222 versus 6.127640. Discrete and continuum already depart at the 3 m bay, strongly at 6 m. Ball-pin internal mechanisms: 1080/480/120, excluding six rigid motions. Discrete vehicle masses: 4950.843/4588.051/4399.690 kg. Remaining payload: -61.401/301.391/301.814 kg, carrying each source allowance and the frequency-2 sag debit; frequency-4 sag remains uncharged. Open force/rise supplement: frequency-6 mean compression 550.519 kN, five-valent incident means 460.622 kN. Rise eightfold retains 538.899 kN and produces 4.248 GPa elastic bending; no eightfold thrust reduction. New nonlinear crossings 5.082444/2.218113 are NOT verified first-instability loads: nearest-zero selection can skip an unstable family, visibly ambiguous at frequency 4. Top-level first-loss fields are null; NFI-026B-04 requires an independently authorized check. Sixteen admitted jobs succeeded and released. One optional baseline static refinement was refused by host memory admission; nothing started, no retry or subsequent scientific launch. The paired m12 rise comparison is complete. Ten package checks pass; 164 manifest files. No certification; stop and await robotics.

Combined MAINLINE-032/032b check filed. All 533 comparisons pass: 236 retained from the immutable 032 check and 297 new engineering numeric/Boolean scalar checks. Both owners’ artifact sets and the earlier check pins match. No owner code read or run.

Conditional 032 lead amplitudes reproduce: S-200F/SR-200 0.152868766846/0.065222906404 mm at 60 psi; 0.089173447327/0.038046695402 mm at 35 psi. Fc still means minimum compression/tension/bond strength; 35 psi is minimum average. Retain the lead-only amplitude/cell correction to 0.00684754923–0.01604921437.

ER-1001’s 0.000065-inch depth converts to 0.001651 mm. Figures 22/30 identify both relevant coupons as 0.008-inch faces. The 3/8-inch slopes remain slopes; derived depths are projections.

Correct Woody’s 3 micrometres to template-adjustment RMS, not finished-surface RMS. Its 24-micrometre estimate and von Hoerner’s historical 0.2032-mm vendor RMS reproduce but do not identify the wrinkle component.

Omitted evidence exists: Rion’s thin carbon/epoxy–Nomex experiments measure cell depths near that system’s critical wavelength, with an empirical shape conversion. Camarda also measures panel maxima, not critical-band amplitude. Neither establishes Be/CR-III waviness.

A conditional flat-panel calculation gives full wrinkle periods about 37–40 mm, near/below Woody’s stated measurement band. No matching Be/CR-III modal measurement was found in the documented search. Ten earlier findings and six new nonblocking records retained. QUESTIONABLE remains. No successor job.

QUESTIONABLE. Corrected filing: the original admission-refusal report was not delivered because descriptive standing text triggered a hold deadline requirement. This report imposes no new hold; the existing simjob no-retry restriction remains. Optional frequency-6, 24-subelement, rise-1 static refinement was refused: 31 GiB charged plus 6 GiB requested exceeded the host 36 GiB budget; exit 75, nothing started. No retry, fallback or later scientific launch occurred. All 16 admitted jobs have now succeeded and released their reservations. The paired m12 force/rise comparison and m24 rise-8 refinement completed. MAINLINE-026b final report rpt-ref-8befdd4c89803adc44a8 is filed locally with 15 artifact pins; canonical delivery remains pending. It separates converged linear factors from unverified nonlinear first-loss estimates. Three original refusal-evidence pins are unchanged. The 07:00 deadline carries the existing dispatch check-in; it grants no execution or retry. No live own work; state SLEEPING.

MAINLINE-038 complete: QUESTIONABLE/PROJECTION. Nine physical test families cover the named P2/P3 assumptions, five register priorities and vacuum holding. First buys: finished SR-200 compression/specification, weighed sealed scarf panel, and wrinkle coupons from the same batch. Initial projected cost USD 23–68k plus shared stock/process allowance 20–90k; biaxial follow-on separate. No quotes, purchases or contacts.

Current P2 thresholds are gamma 0.564164, wrinkle coefficient 0.434628 and compression 300.333 MPa. Newly filed 036, 034 and 022d are incorporated. Latest screened P3 uses both Zylon plies and a 1.035188 MN sized joint target on the 019 line; frozen 022c sensitivities are explicitly distinguished. Vacuum tests separate hot species pressure, trapped gas, desorption and external mass uptake.

A 1 m diameter aluminum shell is a conditional model experiment. Assumed 25 micrometre face/1 mm core fabrication floors imply minimum radii 0.3614/0.4303 m for old/current geometries; no purchasable actual-Be miniature is established. Atmospheric evacuation gives only 6.14% overload at sea-level ambient against the R10 design pressure.

189 source pins and 614 arithmetic/provenance checks pass. Nineteen artifacts include specimen/standard/provider/cost details, outcome-to-SF/reserve tables, scaling figure, calculations and 20 NFI items. Installed-hull SF remains unknown. STOP AND FILE; no successor named.

QUESTIONABLE. No certification. Own arithmetic on the filed 026 card. The owner's scripts were not used. Counts, arcs, annulus A, I, GJ and the mass stack match. Total 4950.84307837 kg against lift 4889.44215019 kg overruns by 61.40092818 kg. The card rounds that to 61.40 kg. At s=2.04 m, w=p s/(2 sqrt(3)) is 56216.627276 N/m, and ps/2 is larger by sqrt(3). The wall screen 0.6 E t/r_o is 1.750799937 GPa. The rigid-joint eigen uses three great-circle chords, centroid-fan pressure, orthogonality constraints and the card's Hermite geometric stiffness. A pin-ended column of that stiffness gives P L^2/EI = 12 and refines toward pi squared. First follower lambda is 6.472325 beside the card's 3-segment 6.472320. Mode residual 8.5e-5. Radial fraction 0.979. The 24-segment lambda 6.465222 is 5.509 percent above the 011b continuum 6.127640. Fixed-direction pressure here is 6.579532 beside the finest 6.571963. Mean compression 550033.7 N, fan volume 4162.62 m3, unit axial stress 0.862060 GPa, wall lambda 2.03095 and member-Euler minimum 7.58222 sit within 0.18 percent of the finest column. Nonlinear paths were not rerun. The published 12-segment ratios and mesh-change column recompute to the card's rounded figures. E stays 410 GPa. Rigid joints and the fan are projections. Robotics sends the next job. Admitted eigen, 1 core, 18 s. The caps-open order stays open.

QUESTIONABLE. The corrected check report rpt-check026-grok-p3-lattice-1020 was ingested on the pass after this door notice. It carries the 07:00 check-in because a standing hold requires one. That instant is not a work limit. No further change to the 026 check.

CHECK MAINLINE-035 complete: REVISE source readings and conclusions; all 112 comparable derived fields reproduce under the owner’s conventions. Independent tensor-rotation CLT, Vc, R/rho and predecessor lead calculations pass; 25 input pins verified. Owner script was not used.

Calibrated S-II hemisphere centers read about 0.21–0.22, not 0.22–0.24, with approximately ±0.01 graph uncertainty. Add the omitted eleventh cylinder point near R/rho=121, gamma=0.61. Replace the cylinder eye fit with CR-1457’s analytic curve. CTA8.3’s printed 0.864 differs from its stated loads’ 0.865305; retain both pending resolution. CTA8.1 was out-of-autoclave; nominal versus measured thickness changes its Vc.

The 0.338273/0.295840 handbook cap/cylinder ratios reproduce, but establish no sandwich-shell transfer law. Additional marine egg-shaped/ellipsoidal physical tests and the owner’s omitted leads invalidate categorical absence claims. Yang’s 12.44 MPa collapse is plastic, not a comparable elastic sphere KDF. Anderson’s retrieved thesis is theoretical. Sim’s uniform-pressure results are FE; three inherited numeric claims remain unreconstructed.

No compatible elastic sphere/dome datum with recoverable moderate Vc at the lead geometry was established. Required lead gamma and the claimed unprecedented imperfection control remain unvalidated. All sourced values QUESTIONABLE; transfers PROJECTION.

Exact fields, graph refinements and qualifications are recorded in 71 rows; sixteen nonblocking NFIs preserve the gaps. Brief names no successor; returning to SLEEPING for the next queued job.

CHECK-036 complete; owner code unread and unexecuted. All 4,945 independent numerical comparisons pass. All 15 strength thresholds and 135 sensitivity optima were independently searched across 47 R10 / 37 R20 cores. Held R10 requirements reproduce at 300.333333 MPa (scarf) and 321.580391 MPa (ideal weld); held R20 requires 376.381907 MPa including eta=0.9. Reoptimized R20 needs 375.839188 MPa with inherited elasticity, 381.612173–381.639359 MPa with sheet scalar elasticity.

NASA Table 3 confirms historical 379.2 MPa at 1.96 mm, not a qualified finished thin-sheet minimum. Three added documents supply context but no matched thin-sheet biaxial allowable. Original Fenn PDF retrieval remains open. All 15 owner qualification NFIs are retained.

One minor metadata mismatch: legacy R20 film label 0.015 lb/ft2 conflicts with governing 0.1464728290914915 kg/m2 (=0.030 lb/ft2); calculations correctly reproduce the latter. Exact deltas include a +0.000020898193 kg payload optimization difference, within tolerance. No material numerical correction. Added film-label NFI; installed SF remains unknown. Full data, source pins, independent code and 107-file manifest accompany the card. Work closed; stop and file as ordered.

baseline_register_report.body: MAINLINE-030 filed: a snapshot at 01:15 PDT. 030b refiles when 022c, 025, 026, 028b, 015b, 029 and six checks land. P2 lead, 021 rev1: S-200F faces of 0.8434 mm at 290 GPa on CR-III 5056 3/8-1.0 (20.21 mm), at 5% margin, with every mode at 1 on two optimisms: gamma 0.595 (2.98x CR-1457's 0.20) and wrinkling 0.371 (1.12x 0.33). Today it is 0.336. On 019's reserve (021b, SR-200 sheet) it needs gamma 0.468, wrinkling 0.609 and 3.13 m panels against 0.914 m stock; today it is 0.427. Gamma is the whole margin. P3 lead, 022b: 1.375 at s 6.15 m. On that 40-node frame the smeared buckle half-wave is 0.57 of a member, so the global formula does not apply (NFI-030-CONTINUUM, computed). Inside the band, SiC with both 011b fixes is 1.130 at 100 kg and 5%, film-limited, on a 1.5 GPa film that does not exist (13x Kapton's specific strength). Today's materials give 0.41 to 0.74. Register: 362 NFI rows from 41 reports, merged into 86 rows with every id, report and file kept; 19 carry a check outcome. Ledger: 14 lead corrections and 74 check corrections. Ground first: (1) a sandwich-gamma FE at Vc 0.9 to 1.1, CPU only, retiring all of P2's margin; (2) a discrete buckling run of the P3 frame; (3) 020's weighed, sealed joint panel; (4) an SR-200 thin-sheet spec, which needs the Admiral's authorization to contact a supplier; (5) a wrinkling coupon. Every value is QUESTIONABLE; nothing here is a certification.

source_index.note: Four pre-snapshot administration reports are provenance context, not new scientific cards. No instructions in old report bodies are adopted.

additions_030c.body:
Independent CHECK MAINLINE-022d complete; owner code was not read or run. All 64 primary witnesses and 1,792 numeric table cells reproduce. Independent starts recover all 176 primary/sensitivity optima within 1e-6 SF; no materially better witness found.

Best equilateral in-band: SF 1.258252476558 at s=3.170758569107 m; arc length/half-wave 3.184193539 m. Both Zylon plies total 214.541557545 kg. Candidate-sized joints weigh 44.191468267 kg and have axial/bond multipliers equal to target. Target extreme compression is 1.198096384 GPa; opposite-face tension is zero.

Exact mismatch ledger: 50 field differences in 16 square-membrane sensitivity rows, from declared coefficient 0.07028850747757764 versus output-implied 0.07028850698306077. Maximum least-SF effect 3.98e-9; primary result unaffected. NFI requests consistent coefficient/truncation documentation.

Required continuum NFI: frozen 026b frequency-4 discrete linear 5.254643802 versus continuum 6.193381346, 15.1571% lower despite the member-wave screen. This is not a universal correction to 022d.

Nine NFIs also carry material/contact reliability, complete membrane, joint density/bond/stiffness, local-shell conventions, two-way shear, manufacture/mass and search extent. Qualified SF, compression allowable and failure probability remain null. Five one-core simjob invocations completed and released; no time budget. CHECK names no successor.

CHECK-033 complete. Requested headline results reproduce; search-domain and numerical-precision findings are enumerated. No owner executable read, imported or run.

Explicit six-mode gamma/Q factors: R10 1.987176/1.836205; R50 1.798617/1.635507. R30 retained-floor payloads are 15,516.287/4,559.419 kg; explicit-bill values are 18,139.202/7,754.736 kg. Crossings 6.822342, 10.358194 (retained scarf) and 16.281905 m reproduce. Q-plus-strength uses the gamma=1 crimp branch.

41,174 arithmetic/source and 1,891 presentation checks pass. Independent search covers all 47 cores, 1,822 cases, 40 feasible subset minima and 975 radius samples. All 49 source/assignment pins match.

Exact findings cover 241 owner paths: 224 wider-fraction-domain comparisons (220 recover on the restricted range; four repeated nonwinning handbook paths retain a 0.040834 kg precision difference), 15 ill-conditioned overlap endpoints, and two polished radii. Active equations give gamma-plus-strength 103.892078332 m and retained-floor Q-plus-strength 40.470082165 m, differences of -0.000197230 m and -0.000030053 m from the owner. These change no winning set or requested rounded crossing. The former remains beyond stock gauge.

CARD, exact CSV/JSON differences, independent programs and evidence are pinned. Twelve nonblocking NFIs remain; QUESTIONABLE/PROJECTION, installed-hull SF unknown. Brief says stop/file; no successor named.

MAINLINE-039 filed, QUESTIONABLE/PROJECTION. On today's record a rib grid or frame does not buy back gamma at 019's reserve. 028b reproduces exactly; the plain sandwich's best least SF today is 0.528. Record, load-bearing rows read at source: the Isogrid Handbook allows 0.425 only for heavily stiffened domes, from one 1964 aluminium dome; CR-62257's geodesic caps reached 0.57-0.64 while its monocoque caps reached 0.78-0.82; SP-8032 gives stiffened domes the isotropic curve (0.14 at a sphere). SBKF's 0.82-0.98 are cylinders. No framed-sphere test found in sources opened. Concepts: SR-200 tee ribs at 0.5, 1.0 and 2.04 m; 026's s 2.04 m frame in SiC and in Be tubes. Least SF today: ribs 0.517-0.586 (0.586 needs 2.2 t of ribs on the handbook's 0.425, with faces 0.75 and seam 0.65); frames 0.512. Least named set: with 028b's seam screen, none for any stiffened version (plain: gamma x2.82, Q x1.32). At 028b's two values each costs 88-257 kg of reserve or payload. Trade: a Be frame stiff enough to make the 2 m bays clamped caps (0.6-0.8 t, SP-8032 curve about 0.6, named optimism O5) lifts today's least SF to 0.689 and cuts the shortfall to SF 1 from 2.80 t to 1.33 t; ribs at 1 m cut it to 2.42 t. None floats. Grounding: that bay knockdown is a one-bay test, cheaper than a sandwich sphere at Vc 0.95, but still leaves 1.3 t, the seam, Q and r/t-300 tubes. 16 NFI rows. Next: none; the robotics seat sends the next job.

MAINLINE-037 checked with independent arithmetic; owner code was hashed only, never inspected or executed. All 541 numeric result fields have dispositions; 84 thermal/projection fields lack reproducible inputs. The 1.771734429 MPa/K term, conditional shear factors 1.678282645/0.917423153, flight-increment 1.003303481 and 70-knot 0.998441984 reproduce.

Ten tube-mass entries disagree: all 022c frames are SiC and use arc lengths; Ti/CFRP label fittings. MAINLINE-037b filed. 037's rigid shear-lag screen gives AF 163-2U's 250 F cure 1063 kPa, factor 0.227, but it cannot hold: the core would carry 47 times the in-plane force at which its walls yield. CR-1457, Hexcel and NASA TM-4585 give the faces the in-plane rigidity. On that reading the continuous bond carries no mismatch shear and the walls sit at 102-122 MPa (factor 2.24/1.87). A free core edge (unfilled splice, closeout) reads 1.17 typical, 0.83 minimum; W governs. The cure's larger cost is in the faces: 4.4 MPa of balanced compression passes through 028b's fixed 30:1 scarf, which binds at its 10 MPa screen, so 028b's usage goes from 0.972 to 1.052 (gamma 0.618). 037's floated scarf falls to 0.9925; any bond stress-free above 54 C does that. Lightest sourced fix, +0.12 kg: AF 163-2U's own 200 F datasheet cure (free edge 1.51/1.08) plus a 30.34:1 scarf by 028's sizing rule (usage 0.972). Room-temperature or mid-swing cures need no scarf change (0.990/0.982) but rest on projections. If 037's screen is kept, only a bond stress-free at 0.4-25.9 C passes. Matched cores (32-85 kg/m3) and RTV interlayers cannot float on mass. Noted, not taken: 028b's 30:1 scarf pins its faces; 30.44:1 alone reads 0.894. Thirteen NFI rows; a checker runs behind. The brief names no next job; the robotics seat sends it.

CHECK-038 complete, QUESTIONABLE/PROJECTION. The nine test families and first-three ordering survive independent review. Of 3,536 arithmetic, export and provenance comparisons, 3,534 match. All 173 distinct non-code source paths match their pins (176 verification records).

Two historical 022c end-mass differences are exact coefficient-rounding effects: CFRP 0.100737586724 vs 0.100734067136 kg/end (+3.519588 mg); Ti 0.511754573507 vs 0.511752793692 (+1.779816 mg). Current 022d targets reproduce; no decision changes.

Current gamma/Q are 0.564163566603/0.434627854375. Independent all-core searches reproduce 036: R10 298.905756 MPa; held R20 material 376.381907 MPa; handbook-elastic R20 381.612173 MPa. MAINLINE-029 completed as a QUESTIONABLE numerical investigation; no benchmarked physical collapse gamma is established.

The paper linear results are 30.217/30.197 MPa versus 27.53/27.56; elastic imperfect endpoints are 13.957/13.844 MPa versus 6.03/5.63. Full 3D paper refinement approaches the axisymmetric value but leaves the roughly 10% linear mismatch. Crushable foam, face plasticity and the paper's contact-generated defect are not reproduced. Native StVK elasticity also differs from the paper's elastic convention.

Both lead points have Vc<2. Their 0.595318/0.468229 targets normalize by the handbook pressure; under p/p_crimp the weak-direction targets are 0.464110/0.323009. At 11.8/46 mm dimples, weak-meridian endpoints are 78.627/90.722 kPa against 95.461 kPa operating pressure. Strong-direction endpoints depend materially on face Poisson ratio. Outer-face equivalent-stress diagnostics reach 661–1304 MPa; face survival is not established.

Lead mesh refinement and an identical static deck across one/four cores reproduce the numerical results. Multicore eigenvalues, CAX8R spectra and initial overlarge reference-load spectra are excluded with raw evidence retained.

The enlarged-shell refined 3D eigenpressure is 6.446068 MPa; its graded nonlinear endpoint is 2.253992 MPa. Resolution and load-control limitations remain explicit.

79 native runs, code, counts, resources, sources and 17 nonblocking NFI are pinned. Endpoints are not proven collapse. No other card is gated. The brief names no next job: stop and file.

CHECK-039 REVISE. Filed-point arithmetic reproduces: 13,176 numeric-field comparisons, 39 headline comparisons and 54 validation checks pass; all 31 input pins match. No owner code read or run. Each concept’s least SF and the original O5 0.689108/+1329.818726 kg points reproduce.

CR-62257, IDH p4.1.012 and SP-8032 p24 checked at primary pages. The .425 recommendation exists; psi>=28 and gamma_s>=10 are model gates, not handbook thresholds. Composite gamma_s 10.400 differs from isolated tube EI/(aD)=3.197. Cap mapping, omitted wavelengths and SiC thermal joint forces remain projections.
Correct plain-Ti 317/917 to .345692; STA8.1’s 759k/754k predictions describe different refinements. Separate fixed-mass seam failures from the mass-added point, where today’s Q/scarf/tube screens already pass. Four compact gs5 shapes require disclosed psi-based recovery. Ten actionable NFI rows, exact arithmetic, source pins and constructive designs filed. No successor or out-of-band contact.

MAINLINE-042 filed, QUESTIONABLE/PROJECTION. Route: hot-creep-formed SR-200 blanks; vented CR-III core fitted to each face's measured contour (S-II's 0.010 in method); face-core bonds cured at panel level at 200 F with a 30.34:1 scarf (037b's fix, +0.12 kg); room-temperature seams made in place, Be cut only at the supplier; panels on a jig with supports at most 2 m apart, or an inflated inner skin as mandrel (my projection); ground evacuation as a 1.061 proof. No autoclave holds 20 m (largest 9.1 m; S-II's 10 m dome needed a 'gargantuan' one). Shape needed at 028b: one dimple at most 9.3-16.1 mm over 0.36 m (015b map) and waviness at most 0.075-0.129 mm (032). Precedents hold 1-5 mm (dome class) to 0.15 mm (reflector class), so the map gives gamma 0.69-0.95; reflector-panel faces give Q 0.59-0.75, vendor honeycomb 0.19-0.28. But S-II's sandwich domes, built to a 0.254 mm fit, measured 0.21-0.22: the map is not the record. The route supports gamma about 0.2 until a built shell is measured (038 T7); Q 0.435 needs reflector-grade Be faces, unmeasured. Inspection: photogrammetry and tracker at 0.1-0.3 mm suffice for shape; bond NDE is marginal (tap a90/95 28-43 mm against a 29-55 mm critical disbond); no scarf-seam method exists. Hardest step: 5.7 km of in-place room-temperature Be scarfs. First build-side test: F1, full-blank forming, panel and in-place seam with shape metrics, after 038's T1 and absorbing T2. 16 NFI rows. Next: none; the robotics seat sends the next job.

A conservative peak-compression local-shell sensitivity lowers those witnesses to 1.033223/0.978132. Bare pins have 480 roll mechanisms; filament-derived film tangents remain conditional. QUESTIONABLE / PROJECTION. MAINLINE-040 common account complete; filed 037b incorporated (200 F cure, compliant-core/free-edge model, 30.341397 scarf). MAINLINE-043 complete, QUESTIONABLE / PROJECTION. Actual frame and lifetime Pf remain null: none of the retrieved grades supplies matched full-member compression statistics. SA is the closest catalogue compression comparison, not a qualified reliability winner.

The selected target has 1.19810 GPa peak compression including L/1000 bow, or 1.26913 GPa with the explicit joint-moment proxy. Longitudinal tension is zero in those ideal fields; contact, hoop and other principal stresses remain unresolved. Frozen 026b recovery covers 1,680 members. Owner rise-8 forces remain independently unverified.

For 433-member risk bookkeeping and hypothetical compression m=10, whole-member characteristic strengths of 4.38651/8.75267 GPa meet tube-only frame targets 1e-3/1e-6. These are 1.12475/2.24427 times an assumed 3.9 GPa scale; the catalogue value is not that calibrated scale. Holding that scale instead requires m=10.996/16.849. Reference-volume and tensile-flaw sensitivities are explicit. Actual improvement factor is unknown.

The needed property is confidence-qualified finished-member lower-tail strength under actual combined stress. Proof qualification would require full-part and joint coverage; an illustrative 1.37428 MN proof exceeds the source stability multiplier. Cost class is high/custom qualification with recurring 100% inspection, not a quote.

Twenty-six input pins, 17 evidence rows, 210 scientific checks and 78 packaging checks are recorded. Four admitted postprocessing jobs released; 16 open NFIs are nonblocking. Brief names no successor: stop/file and SLEEPING.

CHECK-037b complete. The independent derivation reproduces 47.0994x rigid-screen force/yield, 101.517/121.821 MPa walls, W-edge factors 1.166655/0.833325, 4.403103 MPa lead face compression, usage 1.052282 with gamma 0.618429, and the 54.080604 C scarf threshold. The 200 F / 30.341397:1 candidate adds 0.120151 kg at the old lead geometry and reoptimizes to usage 0.972190.

1,734 arithmetic/provenance/presentation comparisons: 1,718 match; 16 numerical path differences are fourteen distinct rounded-L-input differences plus two verdict repeats. Every numeric compute field is accounted for. One source-mass correction: HexBond 679 omits its 30 g/m2 support per interface; increment becomes 519.653569 kg, not 444.255345 (+75.398224 kg). Its independent corrected search still rejects it.

The low-cure route remains conditional: detailed 200 F data concern thicker 2K metal joints, and cure pressure/tooling transfer to light 2U Be/honeycomb is unqualified. Nine nonblocking check NFIs retain this, local/residual modeling, creep wording, interlayer counting and other qualifications; all thirteen owner NFIs remain. MAINLINE-044 complete. No qualified installed-hull fatigue life. Original mooring-pad core shear exceeds minimum strength (SF 0.7143); the corrected metal plates alone reach the declared fatigue-design index in about 950 days. Daily thermal-only core projections are 3,697 days under 037 versus 18,816 days under 037b’s 200 F free-edge fix. These transfer denser-core fatigue data and assumed mean-stress rules. The small 037b fix leaves the pads unchanged and does not cover all combined scarf loads. Actual-geometry vacuum top-ups span 27.56 Pa initially and 8.34 Pa late-year; full venting is a separate pressure cycle. Gross-area adhesive shear cannot qualify sparse wall-foot/fillet contact. A strict ten-year pad allocation plus 60:1 scarf adds 36.66 kg, exceeding the unchanged floating budget; Be-sheet, scarf, bond, local buckling and environment qualifications remain open. No ten-year whole-hull claim. The filed calculation, source data, cycle ledger, mass options and NFI register include 037b. Twenty-one numerical checks, five physical/allocation assertions and 75 input/source pins pass; all 132 manifest entries verify. Nineteen new NFI plus thirteen inherited 037b items remain nonblocking. The brief names no successor; stopping after this report.

additions_030d.body:
QUESTIONABLE / PROJECTION. Explicit 037b as-designed and fix rows now accompany the filed 040 common account. All 120 configurations carry 250 F / 30:1 scarf and 200 F / 30.341397:1 scarf rows; original 040 files remain unchanged.

As-designed field survival does not close minimum-strength free edges: minimum factor is about 0.830, versus typical-strength 1.163. Thus no strict as-designed solution exists within the four optimism axes. Conditional pricing relaxes only the edge feasibility filter, retains every failed safety factor and false pass flag, and reoptimizes the remaining shell/scarf constraints.

At R10 ISA the conditional as-designed payload is -154.130 kg versus -109.649 kg for the fix. At R30 ISA retained-floor it is 4,826.570 versus 6,100.222 kg; the first remains an edge failure despite positive payload.

The 037b +0.120151 kg repair applies to its original 028b geometry, not as a fixed charge at every size. All joining and residual-compression terms are recomputed. All 120 fixed payloads reproduce within 1e-8 kg; mass closure and remaining scalar modes pass. Installed SF unknown. MAINLINE-048 is underway.

MAINLINE-043 supplement folds both MAINLINE-041 frequency-5 closure witnesses alongside frozen 022d. QUESTIONABLE / PROJECTION; actual member/frame/lifetime probabilities remain null.

Each f5 point has 750 members and 1500 end interfaces. Actual lengths and correlated force/moment arrays reproduce target peak compression 1.164235/1.145748 GPa at q=1.143285/1.083205. Positive longitudinal tension remains zero in these ideal fields, without resolving local multiaxial stress.

For hypothetical compression m=10 and common whole-member scale 3.9 GPa, summed per-member peak envelopes give own-screen frame Pf 0.00252417/0.00214283. Required common scales for frame Pf 1e-3/1e-6 are 4.27868/8.53751 GPa (5%) and 4.20909/8.39866 GPa (019). A 1 cm3 calibration instead gives Pf 0.991133/0.979046. No catalogue-to-full-member qualification is implied.

At common 022d q=1.258252, peaks rise to 1.285383/1.337950 GPa and whole-member-hypothesis Pf to 0.00672419/0.00992957; these loads exceed the new source screens. Total volume changes little despite smaller members; surface area increases 18.44%/17.04%. Strength/scatter, tensile-size and proof comparisons are filed.

041's local-wall sensitivity remains 1.033223/0.978132; its sub-unity 019 result is not hidden by fracture projections. Material, joint, instability and lifetime NFIs remain unclosed.

Twenty-six input pins, 843 scientific checks and 77 packaging checks pass. One admitted job released. All 96 original 043 artifacts remain unchanged. Fold complete; no successor named; SLEEPING.

CHECK MAINLINE-042 complete, QUESTIONABLE/PROJECTION. Owner code never read or run. Independent arithmetic covers 413 field comparisons; 20 numerical differences are listed exactly, mainly input precision.

The 9.318267–16.057295 mm dimple and 0.07511795–0.12877362 mm waviness demands reproduce. Map ranges, width dependence and unmeasured wrinkle-band shape remain limitations. S-II's .254 mm matching gap is not measured spherical error; its separate .21–.22 development tests cannot establish a qualified P2 gamma.

Corrected simply supported disbond diameter is 27.127598 mm, versus 29.292133; clamped 54.779991 mm reproduces. Full-cohort tap a90/95 is 41.8/29 mm, not selected-cohort 43.3/28. Neither qualifies Be inspection.

Two-skin seam length is 5683.037088 m at 30:1 and 5685.225425 m at 30.34:1; the latter requires at least 1190 panels/skin under the coverage approximation. Actual layout remains open. Unallocated 028b mass is zero, not 2 kg; core-air geometry and the forming strain/stress pair also need correction.

Cure reclosure reproduces the conditional fix, but the 200 F evidence does not qualify the specified adhesive variant/weight. Fifty-two source audit rows distinguish measurements, requirements, stages and populations. Fifteen nonblocking NFIs specify follow-up; qualified gamma/Q/SF remain null.

All 20 numerical and 1007 package checks pass; manifest pins 375 files. Three admitted jobs released, including a corrected serialization error. No time budget or live own work. Brief names no successor; stopping.

MAINLINE-045 filed. Neither lead is damage tolerant on its own budget. P2: impact dents are narrow (lambda under 0.63), so 015's map leaves gamma alone. But each face carries a fixed 238.7 kN/m on a core that crushes at 0.241 MPa, so a crushed zone over 55 mm (clamped; 27 mm simply supported) grows once deeper than about 0.2-1.5 mm, at BVID. The design 50.8 mm hail crushes about 81 mm and grows on two of three readings; mooring contact at 0.914 m/s crushes through. P2's float margin is 14.6 kg, so no face, core or shield fix fits; venting to 46 percent of the pressure difference (about 2646 kg of air) before hail does. P3: the design hail breaks a tube with probability 1.1-5.3 percent a strike. One lost member multiplies neighbour stress 2.4-3.3 times (linear frame) and drops the film over it to SF 0.84, so the frame cascades. A puncture runs at 1.38 GPa, and a torn bay lands the hull at 23-35 m/s. A tear-stopping film reads SF 0.88-0.98 and 1.5 mm walls read 0.80. A slow leak only lowers the hull: floating neutrally, the difference is M R T/V, plus 1.1 percent from ISA's lapse. Touchdown reaches 0.914 m/s at a 63-66 mm hole, the landing valve is 70-200 mm, and a pressure gauge finds a 0.36 mm hole in an hour. Inspection cannot catch growth, which is immediate. Sixteen NFI rows. The brief names no next job.

MAINLINE-046 complete; QUESTIONABLE/PROJECTION. No installed one-year or ten-year film life is demonstrated. The 022d 5% and resized 041 5%/019 films require retained fractions 0.794753/0.874673/0.923186. Both plies and actual ply stresses are reconstructed.

Sourced humidity, visible/UV, protected-yarn/coating, creep and fatigue records support explicit 1/5/10-year scenarios, not an identified service-aging law. The warehouse endpoint exponential gives ten-year nominal film SF 1.084071/0.985018/0.933256. A separate 0.5%-annual combined-loss requirement gives 1.196737/1.087390/1.030248; the hot/full-restraint sensitivity gives 1.092731/0.995706/0.944784.

At 041, scaled seams plus OD4/white protection cost 95.751 kg. Hot-film SF1 correction adds 0.714/9.165 kg reinforcement. Equipment/protection exceeds the existing 100 kg allocation; no flotation credit. SK99 leads the chemistry-only static mass comparison, but grade-specific creep blocks a ten-year qualification. Protected replaceable PBO is the planning development route, with measured retention and replacement-interface evidence still required.

Forty-three calculator checks, 42 independent comparisons, six invariants and 113 pin checks pass. Manifest pins 117 files; 22 new NFI entries and inherited registers remain open. No time budget. Brief says stop and file; no successor. No out-of-band contact, wake or restore.

CHECK-040 complete. R10 reproduces at -109.649208 kg; 241,388 current-point fields and 3,390 service/qualification/table checks match, conditional on the owner temperature table. Independent searches cover 4,554 saved configurations, 13 primary usage roots and 276 debit pairs. Current search differences are <=0.003074 kg; roots agree within 3.42e-8. R30 retains the stated ranking; no both-weather row floats.

The thermal table itself was not independently reproduced from the written boundary specification: exact differences and an explicit alternative solve are filed. Historical-table interpolation differences are also listed exactly, separately from current arithmetic.

Coating mass is assumed; water is the optimistic 0.1 mm retention scenario. The separate 1 mm scenario removes every primary float even at all four endpoints (best R30 ISA actual: -594.989 kg). The 200 F source tests do not qualify the target 2U .015 Be/honeycomb bond. Including cure compression in global/crimp demand makes R15 optimistic actual -1.821 kg at all-four endpoints; edge/scarf coincidence removes four of thirteen primary floats.

83 non-code pins match; nine executables excluded without access. Eleven check NFIs retain all 23 owner, 13 inherited 037b and nine CHECK-037b rows. No other seat contacted. Full evidence, equations and exact differences are pinned below.

QUESTIONABLE / PROJECTION. MAINLINE-048 complete: 432 configurations, four finishes, three drying routes, actual/retained-floor joining, weather cases and separate dry-exterior sensitivities.

At R10 ISA with the retained floor, 200 F cure fix, 10 g/m2 extra structural primer and projected 90% material-water removal, endpoint payload is +124.262 kg for multilayer CCAg, +121.474 kg for classical CCAg, +17.403 kg for 0.5-mil Ag/FEP and -17.954 kg for 1-mil tape. Exterior water remains 125.664 kg. The primary least set is gamma/Q/film, usage 0.833076. Retained-water R10 weather cases still fail.

The lightest recipe is calculated at 7.5752 g/m2 before allowance; its optical transfer and Be installation remain unqualified. No qualified lightest finish is established. All candidate optics, thermal factors, durability and adhesion gaps are filed.

The 0.1 kg/m2 water debit traces to an assumed exterior liquid film, not sorption. Baking removes only 1.226 kg of the modeled extra R10 material water; onboard sorbent retains water and adds 28.646 kg. WVR and TML stay distinct.

213,078 checks on 7,149 points pass; 56 input/source pin records verified. Wet optics, process/life, cure and inherited hull qualifications remain open. Installed SF unknown. Stopping as brief directs.

CHECK-044 complete: independent arithmetic from pinned inputs, without reading or running owner code. All 25,663 field comparisons match, including 19,619 numerical values; seven conservation/allocation/evidence checks pass.

Mooring core SF=0.714285714; plate-only index=949.846393 days. Rigid ambient minimum-L thermal index=3697.149914 days; free-edge 200°F minimum-W index=18816.049843 days. The relative strict-pad/60:1-scarf addition reproduces +36.661200272 kg.

The +36.661 kg account needs explicit credit for 3.414034 kg of old plates; without that credit, the conditional addition is +40.075234 kg.

All 1113 ordinary cycle rows and nine annual summaries reproduce. Separate vent/commissioning records, recovered pressure/face/Goodman conventions and explicit source tags are supplied. Static-invalid vent indices and dense-core/mean-stress extrapolations remain qualified as projections.

Five checker NFIs are nonblocking. All 19 owner NFIs, 13 inherited 037b items and other inherited qualifications remain attached. Qualified installed-hull life stays null. CHECK.md names no successor; this seat stops after filing.

CHECK MAINLINE-043 plus041 complete, QUESTIONABLE/PROJECTION. Owner code never read, copied, hashed or run. Independent arithmetic reproduces 95,644 comparisons within declared tolerances; zero numerical mismatches and 486 consistency checks pass.

The f5 own-screen compression peaks are 1.164234798/1.145747561 GPa. With hypothetical m=10 and common complete-member scale3.9 GPa, unequal-member series Pf=0.00252416976042/0.00214282731417. Assigning that scale to1cm³ instead gives0.991132667006/0.979046201667. Required complete-member scales for Pf10⁻⁶ are8.53751/8.39866 GPa. All alternate reference, scatter and tensile tables reproduce.

One labeling correction: inherited rise8 mass5446.290626kg is charged total; tubes alone5039.557739kg. Headline probabilities are unaffected. Rise8 equilibrium remains independently unverified.

Selected1.25× target force gives1.259378651× peak stress and member Euler ratio0.375; exceeding the combined/local/global screen is not evidence of Euler-load exceedance. Twenty-one source-audit rows preserve material populations, fitted/reference scales and the old-sheet/current-page property differences. fields.direction: conservative
fields.proposed_fix: FIX-A
fields.note: The card's member force N = pRs/2 is the two-way arch resultant, but the frame it counts has M = 3V-6 members of length s. Statics fix their mean compression at 4*pi*R^3*p/(M*s) = pRs/(2*sqrt3) exactly (virial identity). The card's own Et=(2/sqrt3)EA/s with nu=1/3 gives the same strain. Geodesic trusses of 162 and 362 nodes solved by statics (rank complete, residual 6e-15) give mean C/(pRl/(2*sqrt3)) = 1.017 and 1.007, with a maximum of 600 kN at mean l 2.0 m. Each member carries 0.289*s^2 of film, not s^2/2. The force is inherited from MAINLINE-002's P3 rule (COMMON.md). Yield, Euler, local and Perry are sqrt3-conservative at a given tube. Re-optimised, SiC on the equilateral grid at k 0.2 is 1.408 and 6061 is 0.339. The member-end load at s 2.04 m is 562 kN, not 974 kN (022, 023).
fields.fix: FIX-A: score the P3 members with N = pRs/(2*sqrt3) on the equilateral frame, or count a true two-way frame (M = 2V, V = 4*pi*R^2/s^2), then re-optimise.

fields.title: Finite-strain elastic convention differs from Abaqus
fields.issue: CalculiX2.21 manual6.8.1 identifies native *ELASTIC as linear PK2 stress versus Green-Lagrange strain (St.Venant-Kirchhoff). Abaqus linear elasticity instead relates logarithmic strain and Cauchy stress. Our decks specify no Ciarlet, hyperfoam or crushable-foam law. Large-compression behavior of this elastic approximation is not physical foam behavior. This adds a nonlinear constitutive mismatch; the separate roughly10% linear benchmark discrepancy remains unisolated.

fields.direction: the elastic benchmark endpoints are not structural
fields.note: The card's elastic imperfect endpoints (13.956916 / 13.843652 MPa) are set by the St. Venant-Kirchhoff foam collapsing under the dimple, not by shell buckling. With nu 0, StVK foam carries at most E/(3 sqrt 3) = 7.70 MPa in uniaxial compression, at stretch 1/sqrt 3 = 0.577. At each maximum the foam's most compressive principal stress is near that limit and its smallest stretch is past it: flat 96 x 2f x 12c -7.61 MPa at stretch 0.229; dimple 96 x 2f x 4c -7.48 MPa at 0.353; under displacement control at the card's mesh, a flat foam point reaches stretch 0.0096 at 13.78 MPa, and the path keeps rising to 14.219 through such states. So the endpoint depends on the core mesh and the path. At the card's mesh the flat first critical point is 13.785 (arc-length), with my load control at 14.051 and displacement control at 14.219. Refining the core (4/6/8/10/12 elements) gives 13.785/13.576/13.553/13.431/13.372 MPa, not converged; for the dimple (4/6/8/10) it gives 13.838/13.649/13.552/13.495. Meridional refinement is converged: 13.576/13.566/13.566 at 96/192/384 with 6 core elements. The lead models are not affected by this mechanism: their honeycomb normal strain stays below 1% at the limits (0.36 to 0.78%), while StVK collapse needs 42%. Their core has a different, shear instability (C029-10).
fields.proposed_fix: Fix card, if the EUCASS benchmark is reused: replace the StVK foam with a compressible hyperelastic or crushable-foam law and report the endpoint against core refinement. No lead number changes.

fields.direction: benchmark
fields.note: The linear gap (30.21717 against the paper's 27.53 MPa) is not the mesh, which is converged, and not the load stiffness, which raises the value by 1.70%. It is not the through-thickness discretization either. Two candidates fit. (a) Fig. 4(a) draws the 42.80 mm radius arrow to a point inside the wall, so the reference surface is not stated. Read as the mid-surface radius, it gives 28.076 / 28.061 MPa (+2.0% / +1.8%), closing about 80% of the gap. Read at the foam/outer-face interface, it gives 29.738 / 29.715. (b) E_steel of about 187 GPa closes it (190 GPa gives 27.877, 200 GPa gives 29.049), but Table 1 states 210 GPa. A third candidate, the paper's own discretization (about 2 foam solids through 3.1 mm, 1.04 mm continuum-shell faces, tie constraints), was not tested.

fields.direction: supports the card's NFI-029-FOAM, -FACE-PLASTICITY and -STEEL-CURVE
fields.note: At the paper's 6.03 MPa, my elastic imperfect flat model (96 x 2f x 4c) has the foam at -3.15 MPa principal stress and the outer face at 1015 MPa von Mises (inner face 363). The foam passes the Fig. 3 plateau, read at about 1.4 MPa, at 2.75 MPa. The face passes 750 MPa at 4.56 MPa: Fig. 5 as printed starts near 7,500 MPa, which is impossible for 201 steel, and reads about 750 MPa if the axis is off by 10. The perfect model at 12.45 MPa: outer face 1014 MPa at the clamped edge (750 MPa reached at 9.29 MPa), foam -1.11 MPa. This is consistent with the paper's note that its perfect model buckles at the bottom edge. The factor of 2.3 is constitutive, so no elastic model should be expected to close it.

fields.state: demonstrated in the linear analysis with the card's in-plane core stiffness
fields.direction: Table 2 linear column for 021b
fields.note: 021b's lowest linear mode is a symmetric face-wrinkling mode: the inner and outer faces move opposite, and the mode does not depend on the core shear modulus. On graded meshes it falls with refinement: 230.386 (512), 209.173 (1024), 200.792 (2048), 198.219 (4096), 197.593 kPa (8192); 4096 with grading 2.0 gives 197.582, and 2 face x 6 core gives 198.174. It converges near 197.4 kPa. That is 2.8% below the card's W value of 203.245 and 15.8% below its L value of 234.532; both global modes reproduce. The owner's uniform 512 and 1024 eigen meshes (61 and 31 mm elements) cannot resolve it. Uniform 4096 (7.7 mm) only partly resolves it: L gives 210.188, and W shows only its global 203.244. So the card's 512 to 1,024 check (at most 0.0103%) tests the global modes only. A Winkler estimate gives 677.7 MPa = 187.5 kPa for 021b, with wavelength 36.7 mm; for 021 it gives 913.4 MPa = 308.2 kPa, so 021 is unaffected (191.476 / 160.132 at graded 2048). On the static paths, graded 2048 limit points equal the 512 values (78.631 / 90.736 / 105.077 kPa). Stability of the refined static paths, and why wrinkling there cannot be separated from the core: C029-10. The mode depends on the unsourced in-plane core stiffness. With E_in 1 MPa and G_in 0.5 MPa the graded 4096 lowest mode is the global 203.251 kPa. The card's 0.01 MPa is the more realistic value: a Gibson-Ashby estimate for 1.0 pcf 5056 honeycomb gives about 0.02 MPa (QUESTIONABLE). On the static paths, meshes fine enough to resolve the wrinkle also resolve the core's loss of ellipticity (C029-10), so wrinkling at the dimple cannot be isolated in this model class.
fields.proposed_fix: Add the 021b wrinkling eigenpressure (about 197 kPa, about 690 MPa face membrane stress) to the 021b margin table, conditional on a sourced in-plane core stiffness.

fields.direction: the elastic endpoints are not capacities
fields.note: Along the specified-dimple paths, the outer face first reaches 345 MPa von Mises (the line's SR-200 proxy) at lead021/W 57.6 kPa, lead021/L 59.4 kPa, lead021b/W 43.2 kPa, lead021b/L 45.0 kPa (0.45 to 0.62 of the 95.461 kPa operating pressure). It reaches 379.2 MPa at 61.8, 64.1, 46.8, 48.8 kPa, and the 241 MPa S200F specification minimum (Materion, the card's own cited datasheet) at 42.9, 43.8, 31.5, 32.5 kPa. For 021 the first yield is at the pole; for 021b it is on the dimple flank at r of about 350 to 420 mm. 021b's perfect-sphere face membrane stress at operating is 345.0 MPa (pR/4t_f), so it is sized exactly to the proxy. The card says face survival is not established. Without plasticity the faces already yield well below operating.
fields.proposed_fix: Fix card: run the specified-dimple paths with an elastic-plastic face, or stop them at a sourced sheet allowable (SR-200 or S-200F), and report first yield and collapse for 021 and 021b.

fields.direction: numerical and modelling; extends NFI-029-HOMOGENIZATION
fields.note: The card's core law, C = diag(E_in, E_n, G) in the tangent/normal frame with zero Poisson coupling, loses ellipticity under transverse shear tau. The plane-wave acoustic tensor has det = E_in G + 2 tau x (E_in + G) + x^2 (E_in E_n + 4 tau^2) + 2 tau x^3 (G + E_n) + G E_n x^4, which turns negative for some x = k_n/k_t once tau exceeds 0.088 MPa (W) or 0.088 MPa (L) at the card's E_in of 0.01 MPa. The thresholds are 2.58 / 2.61 MPa at 1 MPa. The card's static paths reach 0.088 MPa at lead021-W 11.0 kPa, lead021-L 11.3 kPa, lead021b-W 7.3 kPa, lead021b-L 6.9 kPa. The discretization sees it once elements are a few millimetres long, below the 9.5 mm cell size. With the far shift (-1000, the true lowest eigenvalues) on graded 4096 x 1.35 (about 3.5 mm): stabsig-4096g135-lead021b-W-a46: 30.0 kPa lowest 0.013; 60.0 kPa lowest -569.718; 80.0 kPa lowest -1059.992; 90.7 kPa lowest -1016.326; stabsig-4096g135-lead021b-L-a46: 30.0 kPa lowest 0.017; 60.0 kPa lowest -55.528; 90.0 kPa lowest -1077.184. The negative eigenvalues come in clusters of nearly equal values on the dimple flank at r 340 to 570 mm (anti-phase for L, mixed for W). On 4096 with grading 2.0 (about 1.35 mm): -0.595 already at 30 kPa, an exact eigenpair (residual 3e-7) whose small-strain quotient 617.9 is cancelled by the initial-stress term -589.1. The core carries 99.97% of the material and 100.00% of the initial-stress energy. The 021b W lowest mode at 60 kPa (-569.7) has 99.95% of its material energy in the core. Its worst element is a core element 3.31 mm long, where the core stress reaches 0.78 MPa. The 021b L lowest mode at 60 kPa (-55.5) has 99.75% of its material energy in the core. Its worst element is a core element 3.24 mm long, where the core stress reaches 0.82 MPa. Its outer-face motion has 33 sign changes over r 302 to 409 mm, a wavelength of 6.5 mm (about two elements; inner/outer correlation -0.99). That is mesh-scale, not the 37 mm wrinkle. With E_in 1 MPa and G_in 0.5 MPa that state's lowest eigenvalue is 0.0197. Along the paths with E_in 1 MPa: stabsig-4096g135-lead021b-W-a46-ein1: 30.0 kPa lowest 0.013; 60.0 kPa lowest 0.011; 80.0 kPa lowest 0.010; 90.7 kPa lowest 0.009; stabsig-4096g135-lead021b-L-a46-ein1: 30.0 kPa lowest 0.017; 60.0 kPa lowest 0.016; 90.0 kPa lowest 0.014; 105.0 kPa lowest 0.012.
fields.proposed_fix: Any refinement or stability study of these lead models must first source the in-plane core stiffness, or model the cells. The card's endpoints are properties of meshes too coarse to resolve this instability.

fields.proposed_fix: Replace the weak purchase-price reference with the primary award and scope distinction. Do not convert it directly into a revised rental or total test cost.

fields.title: SR-200 ductility and available blank dimensions are misstated or incompletely transferred
fields.evidence: The owner's post_yield field says about 2–3% elongation. The cited SR-200 sheet datasheet specifies 10% minimum over a one-inch gauge. It allows 0.020–0.058-inch sheet only at reduced width/length; the 0.7946mm face falls in that range. The assumed 0.6096x1.8288m blank and 18-panels-per-face count are not established for it.
fields.proposed_fix: Use the sheet-specific tensile requirement without treating it as formed/biaxial fracture data. Re-layout seams and price actual gauges/blanks. Carry CHECK038 and CHECK042 qualifications.

fields.title: Statistics wording and sampling populations need correction
fields.evidence: The exact one-sided 90/95 noncentral-t factors reproduce, including k3=6.155281103326 and k10=2.354640131829. At n=3 and CV=10%, the formula gives a finite required mean 1.467373857912, not 'no mean'. It exceeds one only if gamma<=1 is imposed. One cap at each of three different dimple amplitudes is not three iid replicates of one amplitude population.
fields.proposed_fix: State any gamma ceiling explicitly; separate model-discrimination tests from population tolerance bounds. The 10% model-agreement acceptance rule is a proposed rule, not a qualification standard established by the NASA precedent.

fields.title: Core-law instability is reproduced; the reported 7–11kPa range is not the new pair of paths
fields.evidence: An independent acoustic-tensor calculation gives pure-simple-shear loss of ellipticity at 0.087740979 MPa (W) and 0.087868882 MPa (L) with E_in=0.01MPa. Interpolating the owner's new R10 paths at 0.088MPa gives 10.126661 and 16.750523kPa for 16.057/9.318mm dimples, not a 7–11kPa pair. The pure-shear threshold is not a full-state stability calculation.
fields.proposed_fix: Correct the carried range and preserve the constitutive limitation. Replace the unsourced in-plane law or model cells; do not interpret coarse elastic maxima as physical capacities.

fields.title: Core crush, compression and cure qualifications remain distinct
fields.evidence: Hexcel lists W shear 35/25psi typical/minimum and crush 35psi; these reproduce. Its bare and stabilized compression strengths differ from the crush plateau. ASTM C365 explicitly excludes core crush, referring to D7336. CHECK042 also already found that the cited 200F evidence does not qualify the specified adhesive variant and weight.
fields.proposed_fix: Witness shear, flatwise compression and crush as separate quantities; specify D7336 where crush is intended. Qualify the actual face/core/bond/cure stack and retain the unresolved Be compression allowable.

fields.title: Reis and R30 similarity conventions must be explicit
fields.evidence: The 356.777mm width uses legacy nu=0.33; with Be nu=0.0752 its Reis lambda is about 1.0278. R30 R/t_eq is 164.871, despite R/h=285.565, so the two thickness ratios cannot be interchanged in the thin-shell discussion. R30 FE also uses nu=0.0752 while its 040 source uses 0.0768. These are small arithmetic/convention changes inside a larger unproved sandwich transfer.
fields.proposed_fix: Report both ratios and Poisson conventions. Preserve homogeneous neo-Hookean versus sandwich distinctions and compare R30 against its actual 97.172303kPa design load.

findings.claim: Regularized-core model gives SF1/SF1.05 pass–fail dimples 1.209–1.227/0.738–0.756 mm; no physical tolerance is qualified.
findings.source_report_body:
MAINLINE-047 filed with CHECK-029 folded in. QUESTIONABLE/PROJECTION.

The criterion is min(endpoint, first face yield, first core shear). The 255/300 MPa cases fail even at zero dimple. With assumed 345 MPa faces, the governing tested pass–fail brackets are 1.209–1.227 mm at SF1 and 0.738–0.756 mm at SF1.05; single-Gaussian RMS estimates 14.32/8.78 micrometres.

These results explicitly use orthotropic StVK core E_in=1 MPa, G_in=.5 MPa, inherited radial/transverse moduli, and catalog minimum-average/typical shear strengths. The inherited .01-MPa core is not accepted after CHECK-029's ellipticity finding. The stronger regularization is unsourced: no actual-hull tolerance is qualified.

New native core stress/strain fields check current-frame shear and local ellipticity on passing paths. Face yield governs the small-dimple limits; larger dimples encounter material limits before numerical endpoints. Both meridians and all four footprints are covered.

Conditional endpoint division by 1.10 gives a common SF1 bracket 0.521–0.539 mm; SF1.05 then fails even at zero. Transferring 2.31–2.46x permits none. CHECK-029 identifies a foam-law artifact behind that larger gap, so these are rejection scenarios, not empirical calibration.

Cure debit, controls, 015b/042 comparisons and inherited-law sensitivities are retained. 319 native records, 1892 checks, 14 NFIs. Retry and keep-turn-open orders observed. No successor; stop and file.

findings.source_report_body: MAINLINE-055 filed, QUESTIONABLE/PROJECTION. The cheapest test that turns gamma into evidence is three 5 m spherical caps on the true R10 curvature at full cross-section: 5052-O faces 3.10 mm, matched to Be's classical stiffness, on the real CR III 3/8-1.0 core. They are built with the route's seams and a reinforced edge, seeded with 2, 6 and 16 mm pole dimples, and loaded by evacuation plus a water head (sea level reaches gamma 0.593; 5 m of water 0.883). Cost USD 0.42-1.56M; an R30-similar pair adds 0.15-0.61M and a Be confirmation cap 1-4.6M. 038's 1 m foil/foam shells (30-90k) calibrate the elastic FE but cannot measure P2's gamma, because CHECK-029's core shear, face yield and core law are absent. Scaling: the 3/8-1.0 cell cannot shrink without a denser, stronger core, and SR-200 stops at 0.508 mm, so core physics survives only at full thickness. My FE: 5 m caps match the sphere within 1.4%; 5052-O alone keeps the face-yield ratio (0.99), elastic gamma within 3-4%. Adverse pre-test prediction: at 042's 9.3-16.1 mm tolerance the 028b section reaches elastic gamma 0.47-0.51, and its core passes CR III shear strength at 25-38 kPa. Gamma 0.564 needs dimples of at most 5.8 mm, the core 2.4 mm, the faces 1.3 mm. The outcome table maps each gamma band to R10/R30. Three articles per configuration discriminate models; statistical bounds need far more, so results count through a validated FE. First: the dimple specification, 038 T1, core witnesses, rig safety. Twelve NFI. Next: none.

findings.source_report_body: MAINLINE-057 filed, QUESTIONABLE/PROJECTION. Once a sourced concept-stage mass-growth allowance is carried, no hull size from R10 to R30 floats, for either lead, in ISA or optimistic weather, at any of the 16 optimism subsets with every axis at its endpoint. The table is NASA GSFC IDC Table VI-1, adapted from AIAA S-120-2006 (S-120A and SAWE RP 7 are paywalled): calculated structure 15%, estimated hardware 30%, thermal 20%. Allocations (100 kg systems, gas, contamination, vacuum service), the water film, weather headroom and P3's sag debit carry none; the finish's own +10% and P3's joint allowance are credited. At R10, P2's +118.7 kg becomes -588.7 (MGA 707 kg) and P3's +30.9 becomes -649.7 (681 kg). R10 tolerates only 2.8% (P2) and 0.7% (P3) flat growth on hardware, so it needs flight-proven masses. Tolerance rises with radius: P2 reaches 9.9% at R30 ISA (6.3% optimistic), P3 7.5% (5.0%). R30 is the least-bad design point: it floats at TRL 7-8 allowances (5-6%), never at the 15-30% a concept carries. R20 is the smallest size where P2 floats in both weathers at TRL 7. The allowance costs more optimism than exists: the least sets' usage would need 1.78-2.13 (P2) and 4.6-30 (P3), linearly extrapolated. P2's R20/R30 bills are 040's with 048's finish transferred, checked within 0.2-9.2 kg at R10-15. Sensitivity gives payload at R10/12/15/20/30 against flat 0-30%. Eight NFI. Next: none.

findings.source_report_body: MAINLINE-058 filed, QUESTIONABLE/PROJECTION. My own P2 model reproduces 050's five fixed hulls exactly; P3 comes from 052's rows. Two levers widen the band. Relief: size the hull for the -30 hPa day, then climb (or admit air) above it. The worst-corner hot edge rises 11.9-12.0 K for P2 and 6.4-6.6 K for P3, P2's hull is 4.5-4.7% lighter, and there is no upper pressure limit. A low-emittance finish (Al with acrylic overcoat, eps 0.05) moves P2's clear-night cold edge 11 K lower for 0.2-0.5% of mass. Inside the whole bill, P2's worst-corner band widens from 4.0 to 25.7 K at R10 and from 13.8 to 34.6 K at R30. Trim air cannot be pumped out in flight (034's pumps take 11 days to 1.5 years); on the ground it costs 17-19 h per flight day. Climbing needs up to 510 m, ballast 0.2-0.4 t at R10. Thrust buys about 0.6 K for an hour, a kite helps only tethered hulls, shade nothing. At London Heathrow 2014-2023, 24-hour days covered: P2 R10 34% as built, 64% relieved, 84% with the finish, R12 96%; P3 sized at standard pressure and climbing, 78% (R10) and 97% (R12). 95% of days needs R12 with gamma/Q/film (P2) or S/F/J (P3); 99% needs R20 (P2) or R15 (P3). No relieved hull reaches a MIL-HDBK-310 hot day at R30 or below (10%: P3 0.9 t short, P2 3.0-3.9 t). All of this assumes flight-proven masses (057). 17 NFI. Next: none.

findings.source_report_body:
QUESTIONABLE/PROJECTION. MAINLINE-059 complete.

What stays on (a Furmidge drop model calibrated on a measured plate; five finishes): P2's smooth hull keeps 0.014-0.051 kg/m2 after rain with 10 min drainage (upper reading x1.48) and 0.011-0.056 after dew.

P3's film bays sag into dishes under vacuum (024: 9.9 cm crown on 2.32 m bays at R10), so its top bays pond rain. That is 37 kg mean over frame orientations at R10, ranging 5-171 (node on top 55, bay on top 171), and it scales as R cubed.

How fast: an energy balance (checked against 050 and FAO-56) dries P2's residue in 0.2-1.0 h at fair midday and 0.6-7.7 h on a fair morning. Ponds need 65-465 h.

Capacity (own model, cure included): P2 carries 0.1945 kg/m2 in all at R10 ISA and 1.127 at R30. 1 mm floats only at R30 ISA. P3 carries 0.1246 at R10 (052).

Answer: P2 keeps the 0.1 kg/m2 design load and holds it by waiting, at no mass cost. Topcoats add 16-47 kg to save 8-17 kg; heater film adds 503 kg.

P3 carries 0.1 kg/m2 only if its ponds are emptied: with a bay on top, R10 sinks (210 against 157 kg). The cheapest fix is to put a node on top and tip the hull past 14 deg after rain. A night shelter (about 4.9M RUB, floor-scaled) is the fallback.

Ground it by weighing a full-scale P2 panel and a sagged P3 bay after rain and dew. 12 NFI.

Hail: the design strike carries about 32 J, 7-8 times below ice delamination of flat PAN-carbon panels. No pitch, tube or preloaded data.

Answer: not a better lead than SiC.

findings.claim: At 066's four concept optima the model global-buckling and face-wrinkling margins are 1. REVIEW-D's COMMON buckling margins at nu 0.33 are 1.6328, 1.6925, 1.6347, 1.6945. This piece's same formula gives 1.6328, 1.6925, 1.6347, 1.6945. Equation 2.2-14 over P0 gives 1.0634, 1.0909, 1.0681, 1.0958. The buckling gap is kc = 1 - vc/4 while vc is below 2. kc is 0.6771, 0.6701, 0.6764, 0.6693. It is set at model61.py line 106 and model63.py line 113 and multiplies the buckling allowable at model61.py line 120 and model63.py line 127. With kc removed and cure kept, those margins are 1.4768, 1.4923, 1.4785, 1.4941. With kc kept and cure removed, they are 1.0284, 1.0280, 1.0283, 1.0280. Cure then brings that last step to 1. Cure is kb*12.3e-6*dtc*tc/(2*tf) at model61.py line 116 and model63.py line 123, and it sits in the buckling denominator. The wrinkling gap is the pressure adder plus thermal demand. Pressure is P0*max(1.01, QWEATHER)+QWIND at model61.py line 99 and model63.py line 106. QWIND and QWEATHER are model63.py lines 21-23, with no handbook citation in the file. Wrinkling on membrane stress alone at that pressure is 1.0447, 1.0445, 1.0493, 1.0491. grad, bend and cure are 4.28%, 4.26%, 4.70%, 4.68% of demand and bring the margin to 1. grad and bend are model61.py lines 110-111 and model63.py lines 117-118, using 11.3e-6. nu 0.0768 stands as 040's historical SR-200 nu12 scalar proxy. It accounts for the move from the nu 0.33 margins 1.6328, 1.6925, 1.6347, 1.6945 to the model-nu margins 1.5459, 1.6024, 1.5476, 1.6043, and it does not bring either set to 1. Gamma 0.20 and Q 0.33 stand, from CR-1457 as COMMON and knockdown.md state them, with the named hemisphere and waviness limits. kc, the cure coefficients, 11.3e-6, the 1.01 floor, QWIND and QWEATHER have no equation in the opened model text, the SOURCE-INDEX bodies, knockdown.md, or COMMON.md. The 040 case source string names pinned 014b. That pin is not in the SOURCE-INDEX and was not opened. Those four unsourced terms are removed one at a time. BETA stays 1. Vc itself is not replaced.
findings.qualification: No installed hull safety factor is released. QUESTIONABLE inputs. PROJECTION targets.

fields.issue: Neither beryllium nor stainless faces yield in the model. Beryllium inheritednu=.33 is used for comparison, not a verified grade-specific value. Known strength-basis uncertainty of021 is not resolved by these stability runs. NASA CR194164 Table2 reports SR200 in-plane nu12=.0768 andnu21=.0752 for1.96mm sheet. Treating.0768 isotropically at the lead gauge is itself a transfer. Its strong-direction endpoint98.34692kPa leaves only3.02% over operating pressure. A declared.03 sensitivity for021 gives91.468265kPa, below operating pressure. At the baseline endpoints, outer-face maximum equivalent stresses are660.806/835.808MPa for021 W/L and1144.503/1303.532MPa for021b W/L. These are von Mises diagnostics, not a verified beryllium criterion. Face survival to these loads is not established.

fields.note: Section 2.2.2 does not print the critical half-wavelength. FPL 1810-A says cell size changes that wavelength. Delta over the 9.525 mm cell is an amplitude ratio, not a separation of modes.

fields.note: No page read here gives a zero-to-peak amplitude of an as-bonded beryllium face on CR-III 3/8-1.0 at the CR-1457 wrinkle wavelength. That wavelength was not computed on 032 and is not computed here.

A space-mirror or optical-bench sandwich with a measured cell-print depth was not opened. The space sandwich that was opened is the aluminum solar-concentrator coupon, not an optical bench. Publisher gates blocked a 2025 panel-unit abstract on this pass.
A text extract of the local HexWeb attributes brochure contains no telegraphing depth. This pass does not add a depth Hexcel did not print.
ER-1001 prints 0.5 to 1.6 milliradian on 3/8-inch cells and does not print the matching depth. The sine and the slope-times-cell sketches are labelled projections.

Leighton faces are 1 mm aluminum on a machined core. The ER-1001 faces are aluminum foil, 0.003 to 0.016 inch in the series, thinner than the lead sheets, and the core on the depth trace is 3/16 inch. Neither is S-200F or SR-200 on CR-III 3/8-1.0. Flatwise tension and the beryllium bond remain unprinted, so the 60 psi amplitudes stay an upper bound only if that F_c is real.
Treating the 0.20 mm honeycomb rms, or a per-foot shop bow, as the wrinkle component exceeds the needed amplitudes only by using the wrong spatial piece.

fields.title: Finite-strain elastic convention differs from Abaqus
fields.issue: CalculiX2.21 manual6.8.1 identifies native *ELASTIC as linear PK2 stress versus Green-Lagrange strain (St.Venant-Kirchhoff). Abaqus linear elasticity instead relates logarithmic strain and Cauchy stress. Our decks specify no Ciarlet, hyperfoam or crushable-foam law. Large-compression behavior of this elastic approximation is not physical foam behavior. This adds a nonlinear constitutive mismatch; the separate roughly10% linear benchmark discrepancy remains unisolated.
