First grounding route: metallised seamed-panel testing, then HX/cartridge transport and thermal demonstration. Full bills, source conditions, regeneration, defect sensitivities, 16 new and 15 inherited NFI included. 5,949 assertions pass; 88 frozen pins verified. Seven scientific invocations admitted/released; no refusal. No successor started.

changes.source_report_body: MAINLINE-055 filed, QUESTIONABLE/PROJECTION. The cheapest test that turns gamma into evidence is three 5 m spherical caps on the true R10 curvature at full cross-section: 5052-O faces 3.10 mm, matched to Be's classical stiffness, on the real CR III 3/8-1.0 core. They are built with the route's seams and a reinforced edge, seeded with 2, 6 and 16 mm pole dimples, and loaded by evacuation plus a water head (sea level reaches gamma 0.593; 5 m of water 0.883). Cost USD 0.42-1.56M; an R30-similar pair adds 0.15-0.61M and a Be confirmation cap 1-4.6M. 038's 1 m foil/foam shells (30-90k) calibrate the elastic FE but cannot measure P2's gamma, because CHECK-029's core shear, face yield and core law are absent. Scaling: the 3/8-1.0 cell cannot shrink without a denser, stronger core, and SR-200 stops at 0.508 mm, so core physics survives only at full thickness. My FE: 5 m caps match the sphere within 1.4%; 5052-O alone keeps the face-yield ratio (0.99), elastic gamma within 3-4%. Adverse pre-test prediction: at 042's 9.3-16.1 mm tolerance the 028b section reaches elastic gamma 0.47-0.51, and its core passes CR III shear strength at 25-38 kPa. Gamma 0.564 needs dimples of at most 5.8 mm, the core 2.4 mm, the faces 1.3 mm. The outcome table maps each gamma band to R10/R30. Three articles per configuration discriminate models; statistical bounds need far more, so results count through a validated FE. First: the dimple specification, 038 T1, core witnesses, rig safety. Twelve NFI. Next: none.

changes.claim: Concept growth defeats every evaluated P2/P3 case; corrected direct-048 and coating-denominator values are carried by size.
changes.source_report_body: MAINLINE-057 filed, QUESTIONABLE/PROJECTION. Once a sourced concept-stage mass-growth allowance is carried, no hull size from R10 to R30 floats, for either lead, in ISA or optimistic weather, at any of the 16 optimism subsets with every axis at its endpoint. The table is NASA GSFC IDC Table VI-1, adapted from AIAA S-120-2006 (S-120A and SAWE RP 7 are paywalled): calculated structure 15%, estimated hardware 30%, thermal 20%. Allocations (100 kg systems, gas, contamination, vacuum service), the water film, weather headroom and P3's sag debit carry none; the finish's own +10% and P3's joint allowance are credited. At R10, P2's +118.7 kg becomes -588.7 (MGA 707 kg) and P3's +30.9 becomes -649.7 (681 kg). R10 tolerates only 2.8% (P2) and 0.7% (P3) flat growth on hardware, so it needs flight-proven masses. Tolerance rises with radius: P2 reaches 9.9% at R30 ISA (6.3% optimistic), P3 7.5% (5.0%). R30 is the least-bad design point: it floats at TRL 7-8 allowances (5-6%), never at the 15-30% a concept carries. R20 is the smallest size where P2 floats in both weathers at TRL 7. The allowance costs more optimism than exists: the least sets' usage would need 1.78-2.13 (P2) and 4.6-30 (P3), linearly extrapolated. P2's R20/R30 bills are 040's with 048's finish transferred, checked within 0.2-9.2 kg at R10-15. Sensitivity gives payload at R10/12/15/20/30 against flat 0-30%. Eight NFI. Next: none.

changes.source_report_body: MAINLINE-058 filed, QUESTIONABLE/PROJECTION. My own P2 model reproduces 050's five fixed hulls exactly; P3 comes from 052's rows. Two levers widen the band. Relief: size the hull for the -30 hPa day, then climb (or admit air) above it. The worst-corner hot edge rises 11.9-12.0 K for P2 and 6.4-6.6 K for P3, P2's hull is 4.5-4.7% lighter, and there is no upper pressure limit. A low-emittance finish (Al with acrylic overcoat, eps 0.05) moves P2's clear-night cold edge 11 K lower for 0.2-0.5% of mass. Inside the whole bill, P2's worst-corner band widens from 4.0 to 25.7 K at R10 and from 13.8 to 34.6 K at R30. Trim air cannot be pumped out in flight (034's pumps take 11 days to 1.5 years); on the ground it costs 17-19 h per flight day. Climbing needs up to 510 m, ballast 0.2-0.4 t at R10. Thrust buys about 0.6 K for an hour, a kite helps only tethered hulls, shade nothing. At London Heathrow 2014-2023, 24-hour days covered: P2 R10 34% as built, 64% relieved, 84% with the finish, R12 96%; P3 sized at standard pressure and climbing, 78% (R10) and 97% (R12). 95% of days needs R12 with gamma/Q/film (P2) or S/F/J (P3); 99% needs R20 (P2) or R15 (P3). No relieved hull reaches a MIL-HDBK-310 hot day at R30 or below (10%: P3 0.9 t short, P2 3.0-3.9 t). All of this assumes flight-proven masses (057). 17 NFI. Next: none.

changes.claim: Carry CHECK-059's 99%-removal times, two-coat Ultra-Ever Dry bill and unreproduced P3 ponding; 0.1 kg/m² stays provisional.
changes.source_report_body:
QUESTIONABLE/PROJECTION. MAINLINE-059 complete.

What stays on (a Furmidge drop model calibrated on a measured plate; five finishes): P2's smooth hull keeps 0.014-0.051 kg/m2 after rain with 10 min drainage (upper reading x1.48) and 0.011-0.056 after dew.

P3's film bays sag into dishes under vacuum (024: 9.9 cm crown on 2.32 m bays at R10), so its top bays pond rain. That is 37 kg mean over frame orientations at R10, ranging 5-171 (node on top 55, bay on top 171), and it scales as R cubed.

How fast: an energy balance (checked against 050 and FAO-56) dries P2's residue in 0.2-1.0 h at fair midday and 0.6-7.7 h on a fair morning. Ponds need 65-465 h.

Capacity (own model, cure included): P2 carries 0.1945 kg/m2 in all at R10 ISA and 1.127 at R30. 1 mm floats only at R30 ISA. P3 carries 0.1246 at R10 (052).

Answer: P2 keeps the 0.1 kg/m2 design load and holds it by waiting, at no mass cost. Topcoats add 16-47 kg to save 8-17 kg; heater film adds 503 kg.

P3 carries 0.1 kg/m2 only if its ponds are emptied: with a bay on top, R10 sinks (210 against 157 kg). The cheapest fix is to put a node on top and tip the hull past 14 deg after rain. A night shelter (about 4.9M RUB, floor-scaled) is the fallback.

Ground it by weighing a full-scale P2 panel and a sagged P3 bay after rain and dew. 12 NFI.

changes.claim: Carbon remains an alternative beside SiC, with no sourced-compression float; corrected axial load is about 701 kN.
changes.source_report_body:
QUESTIONABLE/PROJECTION. MAINLINE-060 complete.

Compression: ultra-high-modulus pitch laminates (K13D2U class) are sourced at 340-380 MPa unidirectional; the one independent measurement sits 15% below its data sheet. Scatter is CV 5-6% (m about 20). No tube or multidirectional tests exist. 50/20/20/10 fails first-ply at 0.19 GPa: 11.4 times below 2.16 GPa, and 3.65 times below what its stiffness-sized wall carries.

Whole bill (052 line by line, 054's one- and seven-day cavity, R 10-30): no carbon frame floats on sourced compression, even at mean strength with every 052 endpoint and ground service. Best at mean: M55J 50/20/20/10, -470 kg at R10, -4.6 t at R30. Best meeting Pf 1e-3 with carbon's own scatter: M55J 70/10/10/10, -2.0 t at R10, -47 t at R30. M55J tubes weigh 1.12-1.14 times SiC's; floating allows 1.007-1.079.

Only K13D2U 50/20/20/10 floats, and only with compression ignored: +619 kg at R10, +24.8 t at R30. It needs 0.59 GPa laminate at mean (UD 1.06 GPa), UD 1.94 GPa for Pf 1e-3, 3.07 GPa size-scaled. Titanium fittings at a sourced strut share delay floating to R12.

Hail: the design strike carries about 32 J, 7-8 times below ice delamination of flat PAN-carbon panels. No pitch, tube or preloaded data.

Answer: not a better lead than SiC.

Grounding test: compress about 30 full-length K13D2U 50/20/20/10 tubes with fittings to failure; floating needs 0.59 GPa, data predict 0.19. 12 NFI.

(2) The card's core law (in-plane E 0.01 MPa) loses ellipticity at 0.088 MPa shear, reached at 7-11 kPa; refined meshes go unstable on the flank below the endpoints, but stay stable to the limits at 1 MPa. (3) With that core, 021b's lowest linear mode is face wrinkling near 197.4 kPa, below 203.245/234.532. (4) The EUCASS elastic endpoints 13.957/13.844 MPa are StVK foam collapse; they fall with core refinement (13.37 at 12 elements), so 13.96 against 6.03 measures the foam law. Linear gap: 42.80 mm as mid radius gives 28.08 (+2.0%); E_steel 187 GPa closes it; unestablished. Fix cards proposed: core and face admissibility; a crushable foam law. Seven simjob refusals were retried unchanged under the standing order, which this report also closes. QUESTIONABLE; no certification.

changes.source_report_body:
Complete CHECK MAINLINE-048, including the supplied cure/water addendum. QUESTIONABLE/PROJECTION; installed-hull SF remains unknown. Owner executable code was never accessed.

Independent thermal reconstruction, 17,858 design points/1,714,368 comparisons at 2e-8, 1,080 configurations/17,280 subset optimizations and 3,775 favorable-E bounds reproduce. Every main least-set selection agrees; maximum search payload difference 0.000638 kg. Supplemental water/resource/service arithmetic and historical040 checks also complete.

R10 ISA/floor/bake reproduces +124.262 kg; including cure compression yields +118.695 kg. Two formerly floating cases fail with cure. All 432 one-millimetre-water cases remain negative; the best relaxed bound is −998.280 kg.

Corrections: the linked SolarWhite manufacturer sheet supplies 285 g/m² and explicit .18/.89 aluminum-substrate optics, contrary to the claimed missing mass/label ambiguity. Classical CCAg’s cited NASA slide supplies different optics and normal emittance. Twelve null R12/R15 sensitivity least fields have independently verified floating witnesses; populate them or label not searched. Pool quota divided by jobs is not measured marginal cost; 40% fewer jobs and halved coordination cost remain hypotheses.

I disagree with ranking checks as the largest waste. Early checks caught product-form errors, invalid formula ranges and mutable pins. The clearer targets are repeated intake, register reconstruction, rerouting and routine coordination, including Sciences receipts.

Recommend immutable complete input releases; early source/admissibility checks; focused independent checks at consequential milestones; one incremental claim register separating numerical fixes from physical qualifications; validated event types and batched receipts. Robotics retains progress. Compare context turnover by coherent work-piece before mandating a fresh seat per card; measure accepted completions and attributed costs.

Next ground thin-sheet/bond/core behavior, full-member compression and scatter, assembled barrier/desiccant performance, and retention/drying. MAINLINE047's regularized core remains unsourced; 056's 6.03 MPa target is a simulation, not a physical benchmark. The seven-day cavity margin is only 1.1155 kg; weather coverage is not availability. No scientific recomputation or simjob was performed.

# MAINLINE-030d — morning design register

**QUESTIONABLE / PROJECTION throughout. Qualified installed-hull SF, failure probability and life remain unknown. Snapshot 2026-10-20T05:46:07-07:00.**

| Lead / comparison | Current result | What it depends on |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **P2, 048 light-finish R10 ISA** | **+118.695 kg** named endpoint with cure compression; least **G+Q+film 0.842794**, modeled SF 1 | Unqualified finish/optics/bond; optimistic 0.1 mm exterior water; full bill below |
| P2, coated R12 / R15 ISA | Least **G+Q 0.895850 / 0.733994**, retained floor | Cure-included account at R10–15; no both-weather float |
| P2, heavier retained water | **All 432 new 1 mm cases fail to float** | Best all-four −998.333 kg; exterior retention unmeasured |
| P2, 050 weather extension | **No R10–30 sampled size closes the declared 10% hot profile** | Original 048 account; fixed full-range builds have narrower windows than day-design families |
| **P3, 052 resized whole bill** | Ground-service full endpoints **R10 ISA +30.863 kg / R12 optimistic +46.259 kg**; R10 least **S+F+J 0.839340** | Requires unqualified **5.343 GPa effective ply strength** and **15.552h planned ground service** |
| P3, 052 service/weather limits | **No combined-weather or 24h onboard-dry closure through R30** | Chosen f5 family and pump/battery model; no universal architecture claim |
| P3, earlier fixed 041 /046 witnesses | Intact 1.143285/1.083205; local 1.033223/0.978132; ten-year warehouse film 0.985018/0.933256 | Still valid for those geometries; 052 changes section, strength assumptions and account |

**R30 Be burden:** original 040 endpoint **102.231 t**, about **23.6%** of 020's historical 433 t world mine output; finished-sheet capacity is unknown. **Damage tolerance is not demonstrated for either lead.**

**First three tests remain:** finished-sheet compression/specification; weighed curved sealed scarf, including 042's full-blank extension; same-batch wrinkle coupons.

**Preserved:** 98 rows and 961 findings. **Current:** 104 rows, 1553 attributed findings; 18 new reports dispositioned. [Pending work](evidence/cc8c33decf9eec23-rpt-ref-e999413f5ed23130ebf6--PENDING--cc8c33decf9e.json), [complete register](evidence/cfda1d922886628d-rpt-ref-e999413f5ed23130ebf6--REGISTER--cfda1d922886.md), [corrections](evidence/47d0bc7ef7a714a0-rpt-ref-e999413f5ed23130ebf6--LEDGER--47d0bc7ef7a7.md), [optimism](evidence/194055f6977c5e47-rpt-ref-e999413f5ed23130ebf6--OPTIMISM-LEDGER--194055f6977c.md), [ground-first](evidence/0f8746ab4204f254-rpt-ref-e999413f5ed23130ebf6--GROUND-FIRST--0f8746ab4204.md).

## Changes since 030c

- **040/037b fold confirmed:** All as-designed 250 °F rows fail the minimum-strength free-edge screen. Geometry-specific 200 °F/scarf repair is distinct from the original +0.120151 kg repair; positive conditional payload is not an assembly qualification. [040fold](evidence/da4748b1237caeed-CARD.md)
- **043 uses the direct 041 f5 frames:** At their own screens, m=10 and assumed 3.9 GPa complete-member scale give Pf 0.002524/0.002143; interpreting 3.9 GPa at 1 cm³ instead gives 0.991133/0.979046. These are different uncalibrated populations. [043fold](evidence/d7e6bb886c179c1c-CARD.md)
- **Build-route values corrected by CHECK-042:** S-II 0.254 mm is a core-face matching gap, not spherical error. Simply supported critical disbond is 27.127598 mm. Two-skin seams total 5683.037–5685.225 m with at least 1190 panels per skin at 30.34:1. The 200 °F data do not qualify the specified bond. [CHECK042](evidence/e28b2ab11ca1e8b0-CHECK.md)
- **Damage requirement added for both leads:** 028b/022d damage models find no priced damage-tolerant float on their original budgets. Local crushed-core growth and member-loss/film-tear screens consume the intact margins. Transfer to 048/041 geometry requires reclosure; no operating protocol is qualified. [045](evidence/50321a7bff9f1de5-CARD.md)
- **P3 film life and protection charged:** No installed film life is demonstrated. At 041, OD4/white protection is 95.751 kg; hot-film corrections plus equipment leave 31.465–51.465 / 39.916–59.916 kg closure deficits. Ten-year SF depends on the unselected ageing law. [046](evidence/cb0e401429d9e580-CARD.md)
- **Common-account sensitivities and thermal limit retained:** Arithmetic matches conditional on the owner temperature table; independent thermal reproduction remains open. One millimetre of water removes every original primary float. Cure in global/crimp demand gives R15 optimistic actual −1.821 kg; edge/scarf coincidence removes four of thirteen primary floats. [CHECK040](evidence/59196f42d891eb66-CARD.md)
- **Light coating recovers conditional R10 ISA float:** Multilayer CCAg/ITO at 7.5752 g/m² plus 10%, separate 10 g/m² structural primer, 0.1 kg/m² exterior water and a distinct material-water inventory give +124.262 kg at the original R10 ISA bake endpoint. Optics and process transfer remain unqualified. [048](evidence/9aa1ab8f8ed062de-CARD.md)
- **Film label and pad credit corrected:** The 0.060 fatigue-test film is AF163-2K. The +36.661200 kg strict-pad/60:1-scarf scenario requires 3.414034 kg old-plate credit; without documented credit the addition is +40.075234 kg. Installed life stays null. [CHECK044](evidence/2399ea5ea229c75e-CARD.md)
- **Proof and mass labels corrected:** At 1.25× target force the member Euler ratio is 0.375: the member is not shown to buckle. Exceeding the combined screen does not establish Euler failure; fixtures and stress coverage remain open. Required Pf10⁻⁶ member scales are 8.53751/8.39866 GPa. Rise 8 is 5446.291 kg total, 5039.558 kg tubes. [CHECK043](evidence/d306c0c3c346c304-CHECK.md)
- **Direct-frame computation corroborated with exact limits:** Fixed f5 screens 1.143285/1.083205 and local sensitivities 1.033223/0.978132 reproduce. Independent nonlinear continuation corroborates the m24 bracket. Nine printed cells differ, including film-direction and midpoint values; prior postprocessor exposure is disclosed. [CHECK041](evidence/3200c54e4337d87c-CHECK.md)
- **Film-life audit adds quantitative limits:** Required retention and ten-year scenarios reproduce. Coupon-only 458.672527 kg/year becomes 459.261468 with weighted leakage. Warehouse reading uncertainty crosses SF 1 at both f5 points; hot 041-5 annual loss ceiling is 0.457%, below the 0.5% requirement. [CHECK046](evidence/b1abc6cbc2ca59d2-CARD.md)
- **CHECK-040 folded into 048:** 648 new rows include cure compression and both water scenarios. All 432 1 mm R10–15 cases fail to float; best all-four is −998.333 kg. Cure-included R10 ISA bake is +118.695 kg, least G+Q+film usage 0.842794; two marginal floats are lost. Exact 2U 0.015 bond qualification stays open. [048fold](evidence/32200eef53c225c0-CARD.md)
- **050 operational exception retained as history:** A canonical exception report records refusal before execution and a request for retry authority. The subsequently filed 050 card reports authorized unchanged retries and completion. The exception itself supplies no new numerical result. [050exception](evidence/cd7afb006c498994-report.json)

check_verdicts_030d.statement:
CHECK MAINLINE-027. QUESTIONABLE. Not a certification. The owner's card is not rewritten. The arithmetic is independent of the owner's scripts.

No mismatch at the printed precision. 116 feasible P2 geometries were rescored from the published thicknesses. The worst mode difference is 1.70530256582e-13. The worst structural-mass difference is 1.45519152284e-11 kg.

The R 20 m optimistic aluminium pass, full 021 properties and resized seams, has least factor 1.00748732379, governing joint net section. Global is 1.00748732952. Face thickness is 0.00142313261777 m. The published payload, 209.838630802 kg, rescores at 1. The order's 1.0075 and 209.84 kg are those two figures.

Reserve rows marked as constant, area or volume keep those powers. Joining excess is the resized seam. Climate plus internal air is 0.0573961669466 optimistic and 0.131183154179 conservative. The module counts are 1, 3, 7, 23 and 103.

Every re-optimised P3 bay is inside 0.4 to 3 m, and every outer radius is inside min(0.25 m, s/3). P3 scores match to 3.65218966181e-12. The similarity rows pass 3 m on purpose. The held member force is p*R*s/2. On the equilateral grid it is smaller by sqrt(3). That objection is NFI-CHECK-027-MEMBER-FORCE. It does not move global or film. This check names no next job.

fields.issue: The P3 continuation holds the 011b axial force p*R*s/2. On an equilateral grid the member force is p*R*s/(2*sqrt(3)). Yield, Euler, local and Perry are scored on the larger force. Global and film do not use it. The bay and radius bounds themselves are held.

check_verdicts_030d.statement:
MAINLINE-023 checked independently, covering both filings. The load fix passes: 665 numeric fields and 196 display/report comparisons reproduce, including all 43 engineering quantities preserved in the first report. Its five original artifact paths were overwritten; original full tables cannot be checked against their pins. Corrected pins match.

Equilateral equilibrium gives 562166.272760 N at s=2.04 m. The superseded 973700.546722 N explains the original figures. Corrected re-closed masses: titanium 157.685365 kg, Invar 858.578420 kg, brazed wall extension 130.611003 kg, CFRP 31.038987 kg. The sleeve totals are independent of spacing at held radius. Searches reproduce the wrap's shell-only factors 1.465814527 at k 0.2 and 2.060754083 at k 0.4; the corrected five-percent search gives 1.406143581 at s 1.78 m.

The joint-inclusive interpretation needs qualification: bonds/end sections are sized to nominal SF 1, while the reported least factor covers six shell modes. Central node mass and rotational stiffness, adhesive and braze-receiver mass, and coupon transfer remain unresolved. The braze coefficient's units are kg/(N*m), not 1/N. The reference pin's 3d length cannot span the tube diameter.

Primary material sources checked. The wrap remains the lightest partial end-material estimate and a PROJECTION. Eleven nonblocking NFI records include the resolved force error. CHECK.md gives derivations, exact comparisons and source limits. No successor job is named.

check_verdicts_030d.statement:
CHECK of MAINLINE-020 (rpt-ref-3e02218a03708a878faa), behind codex ref-2b226fa1c9f1bf550d9b. No arithmetic mismatches. My own script re-derived all 80 printed numbers (67 card, 6 METHOD, 7 report); each agrees at its printed precision, and 395 RESULTS.json values agree to 5.4e-12 relative. calculate.py was read for its equations, never run; METHOD states the ones it uses. All 48 pins match, and INPUTS matches the 009c5/014b intake (56 checks). Re-reading the pinned PDFs found every sourced value (31/31); OSHA and AlBeMet have no local copy, as the card discloses. Every section carries its tag and a source.

Three objections, filed as NFI rows; none stops anything:
1. Grade basis (fix): faces are bought as SR-200 sheet but screened with S-200F block strengths. SR-200's sourced 345 MPa minimum yield, transferred as the card transfers 241, gives face compression 1.088 at the lead; then eta 0.6 leaves the least SF at 0.65041 (not 0.53535) and the retention screen gives 0.56913 (not 0.53188).
2. Fallback basis (fix): section 6 compares K13D2U with Be at 303 GPa although section 4 adopts 290. At 290 GPa the SF given up is 2.78% on published designs and 14.90% at the 009c5 geometry, not 4.87% and 16.75%.
3. Doubler beryllium: section 3's Be doublers (459/2,066 kg) are missing from section 1's supply and cost; with them, sheet stock is $44.70m/$267.10m (+13%/+59%).

Check pinned below. CHECK.md names no next job.

fields.against: CARD.md sections 3 and 4; RESULTS mechanical_sensitivities and joining eta
fields.claim: The faces are bought as SR-200 sheet (sections 1-2), but every strength screen uses S-200F block values: 283 MPa inherited as 'optimistic', 241 MPa block tensile minimum, and 0.7 x 241. SR-200's own sourced minimum tensile yield is 345 MPa (S03; guide p. 8), above the card's optimistic value.
fields.support: S02 lists S-200-F in rod and bar and points to SR-200 sheet and PS-200 foil below 6.3 mm. Guide p. 8: wrought products are stronger than hot-pressed block in the working direction, and SR-200's in-plane properties are balanced by cross rolling. Guide p. 11: machined beryllium needs a 0.004 in etch on each side, together 27% of a 0.752 mm face, which points to rolled sheet for faces this thin.
fields.proposed_fix: Add an SR-200 row (E 290 GPa, 345 MPa minimum tensile yield used as the compression proxy, the card's own transfer convention, QUESTIONABLE, S03) to the eta and retention screens, and keep 241 MPa only as an explicitly block-grade lower screen.
fields.effect_on_lead: None on the least SF at eta 1. The conservative joint screen (eta 0.6) no longer lowers it (0.65041 instead of 0.53535), and the retention screen becomes wrinkling-governed at 0.56913 instead of 0.53188. Rolled-sheet compression data are still needed (owner's NFI-020-GRADE-ORIENTATION-COMPRESSION).

fields.claim: Section 4 takes 290 GPa as Be's current modulus, but section 6 prices the K13D2U trade against Be at the inherited 303 GPa. At 290 GPa, the SF given up by choosing K13D2U is smaller.
fields.proposed_fix: State section 6's SF given up at both Be moduli; K13D2U's 210 GPa stays the 014b QI value.
fields.effect_on_lead: The Be-free fallback costs less SF than the card shows; the ranking does not change.

fields.claim: Section 3's splice doublers are full-gauge Be, but section 1 buys and prices only the faces.
fields.proposed_fix: Count the doubler Be in the section 1 supply share and sheet cost, paired the way section 3 pairs panels and joints.
fields.effect_on_lead: No SF effect; procurement and cost rise.

check_verdicts_030d.statement:
CHECK MAINLINE-021b complete. Independent equations reproduce the self-consistent 775.729374 kg reserve, all six modes and all 32 subset outcomes across 47 honeycomb cores. Gamma, wrinkling and panel size remain the least named set; the strongest pair reaches only SF 0.900488 at full endpoints. Continuous refinement lowers maximum usage from 0.834205 to 0.833940 without changing that set.

Of 218 scalar comparisons, 216 agree within tolerance. Two RMS fields reproduce only with the inherited width-map nu=.30 rather than mechanical nu=.33. Seven NFI rows record that width/convention issue, tensile-to-compressive strength transfer, unsourced isotropic nu, grade/modulus coupling, pressure envelope, thin-panel/gauge capability, and joint/service assumptions. The subset table retains E290 even when strength changes; coupling the cited E293.6 changes secondary scores but no feasibility outcome. The 345 MPa compression assumption and formed-sheet capability remain unqualified. At +1% pressure, the exact needed-value point has minimum SF 0.990099. A lower-nu sensitivity retains the same set after retuning.

All seven owner pins match again at completion; nine upstream and four tolerance pins matched on intake. Primary source audits, exact discrepancies, both searches and reproducible calculations are pinned. No owner program was inspected, executed or imported. NFIs do not stop work. No next job is named.

fields.issue: 345 MPa is the SR-200 datasheet minimum tensile yield, used as compressive. It is not a sourced compressive minimum at 0.691748 mm or after forming. The historical 379.2 MPa compression is a 1.96 mm sheet lot, not a thin-sheet minimum.
fields.implication: The three-of-five result is conditional on an additional, unvaried material transfer assumption. The card already flags this, so this is a carried source limitation, not an arithmetic error.
fields.source: Materion DS-HPP-613; NASA CR-194164 PDF p.22 Tables 2–3
fields.needed_evidence: Thin-sheet post-form compression and biaxial properties, with gauge and orientation.

fields.issue: The isotropic 0.33 value is inherited from aluminium, not established for SR-200. The cited lot has substantially lower in-plane Poisson ratios.
fields.implication: At nu=.0768, fixed-geometry global SF is 0.961118. Retuning the same gamma/wrinkle/panel set works at usage about 0.883289. This scalar substitution is a sensitivity, not an orthotropic laminate solution.
fields.needed_evidence: A consistent orthotropic shell model and sourced thin-sheet elastic tensor.

consistent_nu033.width_note: Amplitude is from lambda_I=1; rms_worst changes only width to 2.625 and is not a coupled knockdown/tolerance pair.

fields.issue: The two filed RMS values use nu=.30 for angular width, while mechanics inherit nu=.33. More substantially, amplitude is inverted from a lambda_I=1 fit and then the RMS width is set to 2.625; that is not a single defect with a demonstrated knockdown/amplitude/RMS tuple.
fields.implication: 45.819441 mm amplitude reproduces. With width nu=.33, the same lambda_I=1 Gaussian gives 0.654416 mm whole-sphere RMS; merely changing width gives 1.717842 mm, not a validated tolerance at the same knockdown. The filed 1.708852 mm is reproduced with width nu=.30.
fields.source: Baizhikova et al., doi:10.1016/j.jmps.2025.106468, Eq.2–3 and section 4.1; MAINLINE-015
fields.needed_evidence: State width and nu together; calculate a coupled defect response for the sandwich, including seams and multiple defects.

fields.issue: The complete subset table reproduces with E=290 GPa even when O3 is selected. Full-named-set mode and family calculations instead use 293.6 GPa. Thus the subset table does not literally couple every O3 strength choice to the stated alternate lot modulus.
fields.implication: Using E=293.6 GPa whenever O3 is selected changes secondary scores, e.g. all five to 0.708874 on the same grid. No subset feasibility changes and no two-member set floats. The chosen three-member set has no O3, so its answer is unchanged.
fields.needed_evidence: Declare whether keeping 290 GPa is intentional conservatism; if grade and strength co-vary, specify interpolation and recompute the usage objective.

fields.issue: The printed point scores the COMMON reference pressure. The inherited service package includes a 1% pressure swing; its high-pressure structural corner is separate from the low-pressure buoyancy corner.
fields.implication: At +1% external pressure on the same geometry and needed values, global and wrinkle SF are 0.990099, compression 0.990103. This does not contradict the reference-case arithmetic but prevents treating that exact point as covering the complete service package.
fields.needed_evidence: Retune against the specified pressure envelope and retain the separate low-pressure/hot buoyancy budget.

fields.implication: Even the today panel endpoint is a thin-sheet transfer. A uniform minus-0.1016-mm gauge screen at fixed core reduces compression SF to 0.853129 and wrinkling SF to 0.787988; this is a sensitivity, not a prediction of the delivered gauge distribution.

fields.issue: The correct mass closure still assumes sealed service, zero payload, the chosen weather/water condition, 60 mm strips, 0.2 mm seam adhesive, 1.5 mm core splice and no demonstrated Be/core bond at the nominated film weight. These are explicit inputs, not measured capabilities.

CHECK MAINLINE-030. The half-wave test, the today factors 0.336 and 0.427, and the in-band film 1.130 stand. The printed coefficient 1.06 is a rounding of the coefficient that was computed. It does not move the conclusion.

The stored half-wave is pi times the square root of (3/4)*rg*R. rg is the tube value sqrt((ro^2+ri^2)/2). That is the same as pi times the square root of 1.06066*rg_thin*R, and the sentence rounds 1.06066 to 1.06. With that printed 1.06, the 022b wave is 3.51309 m against the stored 3.51418 m. The ratio stays 0.571. At s 6.15 m the half-wave is shorter than the member, so the smeared mode does not describe the 40-node frame and the filed optimum is outside the band. At s 2.04 m the ratio is 1.481. Member force p*R*s/(2*sqrt(3)) is 1.694766 MN.

Today's least factor is the needed global factor scaled by 0.20 over gamma. 0.20/0.59532 is 0.336. 0.20/0.46823 is 0.427.

The in-band film factor is 1.5 GPa times 80 µm, divided by (p/2) times 2.224 m, which is 1.13045. Twenty merged rows hold 117 source pointers, and every cited row id is in its NFI file. Unique source rows are 362. One note, NFI-CHK011B-TEXT, is cited on R057 and on R079, and the note contains both subjects. No next job.

fields.issue: REGISTER.md writes the smeared half-wave as pi*sqrt(1.06*rg*R). The stored waves match pi*sqrt((3/4)*rg_section*R), which is pi*sqrt(1.06066*rg_thin*R). Using the printed 1.06 with the stored thin-ring rg shortens the 022b wave by 1.094 mm, from 3.514184 m to 3.513090 m.
fields.consequence: The ratio stays 0.571 at s 6.15 m and 1.481 at s 2.04 m. The half-wave is still shorter than the 6.15 m member, so 022b's continuum optimum stays outside the band. This does not stop the card.
fields.next: Write 1.06066, or 3/4 on the section radius of gyration, in the sentence that cites CONTINUUM.json.

CHECK MAINLINE-028b. QUESTIONABLE. Not a certification. The owner's card is not rewritten. The arithmetic is independent of the owner's scripts.

No mismatch at the printed precision. Fourteen published floating points were rebuilt from the fixed reserve, stock panels and the joining bill. Mass, seam length and the six modes match.

Two factors suffice. On the seam-enforced sheet-Poisson points the least set is gamma and wrinkling. Nominal usage is 0.97197751743, primer usage is 0.996076438087, and the laboratory weld usage is 0.651468543105. Gamma alone stays above 1. Wrinkling alone, face strength alone, and the empty set stay infeasible. Adding face strength leaves the two-factor usage unchanged.

The 255 MPa sensitivity has no floating set. With zero core and the whole structural budget in the faces, the compression factor is 0.958217295476. Core mass or joint excess leaves a thinner face. The published full-endpoint screens stay below 1. The highest is 0.870902327232.

The 10 MPa scarf screen sets the two higher usages. The screen is an assumed numerical limit. That objection is NFI-CHECK-028B-SEAM-SCREEN. The face-budget bound is NFI-CHECK-028B-255-BOUND. This check names no next job.

fields.note: The 0.97197751743 and 0.996075 usages are set by the assumed 10 MPa scarf-shear screen, which caps face stress at 300.333333 MPa. That screen is not a measured beryllium scarf allowable. The laboratory 0.651468543105 usage is the same with the screen off, because the ideal weld is scored as parent face compression.

With the fixed reserve and systems removed, the largest face thickness at zero core is 0.000896786528723 m and the 255 MPa compression factor is 0.958217295476. Core mass or joint excess leaves less face thickness. No gamma or wrinkling value changes that face factor.

Calibrated S-II hemisphere centers read about 0.21–0.22, not 0.22–0.24, with approximately ±0.01 graph uncertainty. Add the omitted eleventh cylinder point near R/rho=121, gamma=0.61. Replace the cylinder eye fit with CR-1457’s analytic curve. CTA8.3’s printed 0.864 differs from its stated loads’ 0.865305; retain both pending resolution. CTA8.1 was out-of-autoclave; nominal versus measured thickness changes its Vc.

The 0.338273/0.295840 handbook cap/cylinder ratios reproduce, but establish no sandwich-shell transfer law. Additional marine egg-shaped/ellipsoidal physical tests and the owner’s omitted leads invalidate categorical absence claims. Yang’s 12.44 MPa collapse is plastic, not a comparable elastic sphere KDF. Anderson’s retrieved thesis is theoretical. Sim’s uniform-pressure results are FE; three inherited numeric claims remain unreconstructed.

No compatible elastic sphere/dome datum with recoverable moderate Vc at the lead geometry was established. Required lead gamma and the claimed unprecedented imperfection control remain unvalidated. All sourced values QUESTIONABLE; transfers PROJECTION.

Exact fields, graph refinements and qualifications are recorded in 71 rows; sixteen nonblocking NFIs preserve the gaps. Brief names no successor; returning to SLEEPING for the next queued job.
